1: Ji mang'eny osebedo ka chano weche mane otimore e dierwa,
mana kaka nochiwgi ne wan kod jogo motelo mane joneno wang'giwang' kendo jotich wach.
Kuom mano, an bende kaka asenono tiend wechegi maler chakre a chakruok, en gimaber bende mondo andikni e yo mochanore maler, in mulour Theofilo,
mondo ing'e adier mar gik mosepwonji.
E ndalo ma Herode ne ruodh Judea, ne nitie jadolo ma nyinge Zakaria, ma ne en achiel kuom oganda jodolo mag Abija; chiege Elizabeth bende ne nyar dhood Harun.
Gi duto jariyogo ne gin joma kare nyim Nyasaye, ne girito chike madongo gi matindo mag Ruoth Nyasaye, maonge ketho.
To ne gionge gi nyithindo, nikech Elizabeth ne migumba, kendo gin jariyogo hikgi noseang'.
Chieng' moro kane oganda gi Zakaria ne ni e tich to notiyo kaka jadolo e nyim Nyasaye,
noyiere gi ombulu kaka chik mar jodolo, mondo odonji ei hekalu mar Ruoth kendo owang' ubani.
To ka sa mar wang'o ubani ochopo, jolemo duto nochokore oko kendo negilamo.
Eka malaika mar Ruoth Nyasaye nofwenyorene, kochungo bath kendo mar ubani korachwich.
Kane Zakaria onene, ne obwok kendo luoro nomake.
To malaika nowachone ni, "Kik ibed maluor, Zakaria; lamoni osewinji. Chiegi Elizabeth biro nyuoloni wuowi, kendo inichake Johana."
Obiro bedo ni mor kod ilo, to ji mang'eny nomor nikech nyuolne,
nimar enobed ng'at maduong' enyim Ruoth. Ok nomadh divai kata kong'o makech, to enopong' gi Roho Maler chakre nyuolne.
Obiro kelo jo-Israel mang'eny ir Ruoth Nyasachgi.
Kendo notel nyim Ruoth, gi chuny kod teko mar Eliya, koduogo chunje wuone ir nyithindgi, kendo koloko joma wigi tek mondo oluw rieko mar ji makare - koiko oganda mowinjore ni Ruoth.
Zakaria nopenjo malaika niya, "Ere kaka dang'e ni wachni en adier? An ng'at moti kendo chiega bende hike oseang'."
Malaika nodwoko ni, "An Gabriel, achungo e nyim Nyasaye, kendo oseora mondo awuo kodi kendo nyisi wach maberni."
To koro ibiro bedo momo kendo ok iniwinj nyaka ndalo ma gini notimre, nikech ne ok iyie wechena, mabiro bedo adiera e kindegi mowinjore.
E kindeno, ji nerito Zakaria kendo negiwuoro ni ang'o momiyo osebedo aming'a ei Hekalu.
Kane owuok oko, ne ok nyal wuoyo kodgi. Negingeyo ni nose neno fweny ei Hekalu, nimar nosiko konyisogi gik moko gi lwete to ne ok onyal wuoyo.
Ka kindene mar tich norumo, nodok dala.
Bang' mani chiege Elizabeth nomako ich to kuom dweche abich ne ok owuok oko.
Nowacho ni, "Ruoth Nyasaye osetimona ma. E ndalogi osenyiso ng'wonone kuoma kendo ogolana wichkuot e kind ji."
E dwe mar auchiel, Nyasaye nooro malaika Gabriel odhi Nazareth, taon manie Galili,
ir nyako moro mane pok ong'eyo dichwo, mane osesingore mondo okende gi ng'ato ma nyinge Josef ma nyakwar Daudi. Nying nyako mapok ong'eyo dichwo ne en Mariam.
Malaika nodhiyo ire momosene, "Amosi, in jal mokechi moloyo! Ruoth ni kodi."
Wechego nochando chuny Mariam ahinya, to nowuoro mos mane omosego no, ni tiende ang'o.
To malaika nowachone ni, "Kik iluor Mariam, nikech Nyasaye osetimoni ng'wono.
Ibiro bedo gi nyathi kendo ininyuol wuowi, to inimiyie nying ni Yesu.
Obiro bedo maduong' kendo noluonge Wuod Ng'at Mamalo Moloyo. Ruoth Nyasaye biro miye kom loch mar kwar mare, Daudi.
To enobed gi loch kuom od Jakobo nyakachieng' lochne ok bi rumo ngang'."
Mariam nopenjo malaika ni, "Mani biro bedo nadi, to pod an nyako mapok ong'eyo dichwo?"
Malaika nodwoko ni, "Roho Maler biro kuomi, kendo teko mar Ng'at ma malo moloyo biro umoi. Kuom mano jal maler monego nyuol ibiro luongo ni Wuod Nyasaye.
Bende ng'e ni Elizabeth ma watni biro bedo gi nyathi e hike moniang', to jalo mane iluongo ni migumba no, koro en gi ich mar dweche auchiel.
Nimar onge gima nyalo tamo Nyasaye."
Mariam nodwoko ni, "An jatich Ruoth, onego timre kaka iwacho." Eka malaika noweye.
E kindeno Mariam noikore mowuok mapiyo kodhi e piny motimo gode mar Judea,
kama nodonjo e dala Zakaria kendo nomoso Elizabeth.
Ka Elizabeth nowinjo mos mar Mariam nyathi notugo e iye kendo Elizabeth nopong' gi Roho Maler.
Gi duol maduong' nomor kowachoni, "In jal moguedhi kuom mon, kendo oguedhi nyathi ma ibiro nyuolo!
To ang'o momiyo obed manguon koda, momiyo min Ruodha dibi ira?
Piyo piyo nono ka mosni ochopo e ita, nyathi manie iya notugo gi mor.
Oguedhi jalno moseyie ni gima Ruoth osewachone ibiro timo."
To Mariam nowacho niya, "Chunya opako Ruoth
Kendo chunya oil kuom Nyasaye Jawarne,
Nimar oseparo dhier mar jatichne. Chakre kawuononi tienge duto biro luonga ni mogwedhi,
Nimar Jal Maratego osetimona gik madongo. Nyinge ler.
Kechne chopo kuom jogo moluore, a tieng' ka tieng'.
Osetimo timbe madongo gi bade, okeyo jogo masungore e parogi maiye.
Osegolo ruodhi e kombegi to oseting'o malo jomamuol.
Oseyiengo jokech gi gik mabeyo to oseriembo jomwandu gi lwetgi nono.
Osekonyo jatichne Israel, koparo bedo mang'won,
ne Abraham kod nyikwaye nyakachieng', mana kaka nowacho ni kwerewa."
Mariam nobet gi Elizabeth kuom dweche madirom adek to eka nodok thurgi.
Kane en kinde mane Elizabeth onego yudie nyathi, nonyuolo nyathi ma wuowi.
Jogweng' kod wedene nowinjo ni Ruoth Nyasaye osetimone kech maduong' mi gimor kode.
Chieng' mar aboro negibiro mondo giter nyathi nyangu kendo ne gidwaro chake nying wuon-gi Zakaria,
to min-gi nowuoyo kendo wacho ni, "Ooyo! Ibiro luonge ni Johana."
Negiwachone ni, "Onge ng'ato moro kuom wedeni man-gi nyingni."
Eka negiwuoyo gi wuon mare gi lwetgi, mondo giyud ni en nying mane madoher luong nyathi.
Nokwayo bao mar ndiko kendo ji duto nowuoro ka nondiko ni, "Nyinge en Johana."
Gikanyono dhoge noyawore kendo lewe nogonyore, to nochako wuoyo, kopako Nyasaye.
Luoro nomako jogweng' duto, kendo ji duto manie piny gode Judea ne loso kuom wechegi duto.
Ng'ato ka ng'ato manowinjo mani newuoro mani, kapenjo ni, "Nyathini biro bedo machal nadi?" Nimar lwet Ruoth ne ni kode.
Wuon mare Zakaria nopong' gi Roho Maler kendo nokoro wach kama:
"Pak obed ni Ruoth Nyasach Israel; nikech osebiro kendo osereso joge.
Osechungonwa tung' mar warruok marwa, e od jatichne Daudi,
(kaka nowacho gi dho jonabige maler mag ndalo machon),
warruok ae lwet wasikwa, kendo ae lwet jogo duto mamon kodwa,
onyis kech ni kwerewa, kendo opar singruokne maler,
singruok mane okwong'orego ni kwarwa Ibrahim,
mondo oreswa e lwet wasikwa kendo miyo watine maonge luoro,
e ler kod tim makare e nyime ndalowa duto.
To in, nyathina, ibiro luongi ni janabi mar Ng'at Man Malo Moloyo, nimar ibiro telo nyim Ruoth mondo iikne yo,
kendo imi joge ng'eyo mar warruok kuom weruok mar richogi,
nikech ng'wono mamuol mar Nyasachwa, ma chieng' mawuok biro go irwa koa e polo,
mondo orieny kuom jogo modak e mudho, kendo nie tipo mar tho, mondo otel ni tiendwa e yor kuwe."
To nyathi nodongo kendo nobedo motegno e chuny; to nodak e thim nyaka nonyisore ratiro e nyim Israel.
2: E ndalogo, Kaisar Agusto nogo chik mondo okwan ji e piny Rum duto.
Ma ne en kweno mokwongo, mane otimore ka Kwirinio ne en ruodh Siria.
To ng'ato ka ng'ato nodhi e taondgi owuon mondo ondik nyinge.
Kuom mano, Josef bende noa e taon mar Nazareth, Galili, modhiyo Judea yaka Bethlehem, taon mar Daudi, nikech ne en achiel kuom joodgi kendo anyuola gi Daudi.
Nodhiyo kuno mondo okwane kod Mariam, mane osingore mondo okendi, kendo nogeno yudo nyathi.
Kane gin kuno, kinde mar nyuolo nyathi nochopo,
to nonyuolo nyathine makayo ma wuowi. Ne oboye gi nanga kendo nokete e sanduk mar chiemb dhok, nikech ne onge od welo.
To ne nitie jokwath rombe manodak oko e lek machiegini kanyo, kagirito jambgi gotieno.
Malaika mar Ruoth nobiro irgi, kendo duong' mar Ruoth Nyasaye norieny molworogi, mi negiluor ahinya.
To malaika nowachonigi niya, "Kik uluor. Nimar, ne, akelonowu wach maber mar mor maduong' mabiro bedo ni ji duto.
Kawuononi e taon mar Daudi, Jawar osenyuolnu; en Kristo Ruoth.
Mani nobednu ranyisi: Ubiro yudo nyathi mo-boyo gi nanga ka onindo e sanduk mar chiemb dhok."
Apoya nono oganda maduong' mar jopolo nothinyore kod malaika, kagipako Nyasaye kendo giwacho ni,
"Duong' ni Nyasaye man e polo malomalo, kendo e piny kuwe e dier ji ma odiegi."
Kane malaika noseweyo jogi kendo odhi e polo, jokwath nowacho kendgi ni, "Wadhiuru Bethlehem mondo wane gima osetimore, ma Ruoth osenyisowa kuome."
Kuom mano, ne gidhiyo mapiyo kendo negiyudo Mariam gi Josef, kod nyathi konindo e sanduk mar chiemb dhok.
Kane gisenene, negilando wach mane owachnigi kuom nyathini.
Kendo ji duto manowinjo wachni nowuoro gima jokwath nowachonigi.
To Mariam nokano wechego duto, kendo oparogi e chunye.
Jokwath nodok, kagipako Nyasaye kendo miyo Nyasaye duong' kuom gik moko duto mane gisewinjo kendo neno, mane obedo mana kaka nosenyisgi.
Chieng' ndalo mar aboro, kane kinde monego otere nyangu ochopo, nomiye nying ni Yesu, nyingno mane malaika osemiye kapok omak ichne.
Kane kinde mag pwodhruokgi kaka Chik mar Musa dwaro ochopo, Josef gi Mariam notere Jerusalem mondo gichiwe ni Ruoth,
mana kaka ondiki e Chik mar Ruoth ni, "Nyathi ka nyathi makayo mawuowi nyaka wal ni Ruoth,"
kendo mondo gichiw misango koluwore gi gima owachi e Chik mar Ruoth ni, "akuche ariyo kata akuche odugla matindo ariyo."
E kindeno ne nitie ng'at moro e Jerusalem miluongo ni Simeon; ne en ng'at makare kendo moluoro Nyasaye, norito hoch mar Israel, kendo Roho Maler ne ni kuome.
Nosefwenyne gi Roho Maler ni ok obi tho kapok oneno Kristo mar Ruoth.
Kotere gi Roho, nodhiyo e hekalu; kendo kane jonyuol okelo nyathi Yesu mondo gintimne gima chik dwaro,
Simeon nokawe e bade, mi nopako Nyasaye kowacho niya,
"Ruoth ma Jaduong', sani igonyo misumbani gi kuwe, kaka ne isesingo;
nimar wang'a oseneno warruok mari,
mane ikano e nyim ji duto,
ler mar fweny ni Ogendini, kendo duong' ni jogi Israel."
Wuon nyathi gi minne nowuoro kuom weche mane owach kuome.
Eka Simeon noguedhogi, kendo nowacho ni Mariam minne niya, "Ne, nyathini oketi mondo okel podho gi chung' mar ji mang'eny e Israel, kendo obed ranyisi mabiro bedo gi akwede,
kendo ligangla bende biro chuoyo chunyi in iwuon, mondo weche mag chuny ji mang'eny ogol e ler."
Kendo ne nitie janabi madhako bende, miluongo ni Ana, nyar Fanuel mar dhood Asher. Ne oti ahinya kendo ne osedak gi chuore higini abiriyo bang' kendne,
eka nobedo chi liel nyaka koro ne en jahigni piero aboro go-gang'wen. Ne ok oa e hekalu, to nolamo Nyasaye otieno gi odiechieng', koriyo kech kendo olemo.
Kobiro irgi gie kindeno, nogoyo erokamano ni Nyasaye, kendo nowuoyo kuom nyathino ni ji duto mane rito resruok mar Jerusalem.
Kane Josef gi Mariam gisetimo duto mane dwarore koluwore gi Chik mar Ruoth, negidok Galili e taondgi owuon miluongo ni Nazareth.
To nyathi nodongo, kendo omedo bedo motegno; nopong' gi rieko, kendo ng'wono mar Nyasaye ne ni kuome.
Jonyuolne nedhiyo Jerusalem higa ka higa e Sawo mar Pasaka.
Kendo kane en jahigni apar gariyo, negidhiyo Jerusalem koluwore gi tim margi mar sawo.
Bang' ka sawo norumo, kagidok dala, wuowi Yesu nodong' chien Jerusalem, to Josef gi minne ne ok ong'eyo.
To kagiparo ni ne en e dier jowuothgi, negiwuotho moromo ndalo achiel, eka negichako manye e dier wedegi kod osiepegi.
Kendo kane ok giyude, negidok Jerusalem mondo gimanye.
Bang' ndalo adek, negiyude e hekalu, kobedo e dier jopuonj, kowinjogi kendo openjogi penjo.
Kendo ji duto mane winje nowuoro ng'eyone kod dwokone.
Kane jonyuolne onene, negihum malich. Minne nowachone ni, "Wuowi, ang'o momiyo isetimonwa kamani? Ne, wuonu koda wasedwaroi gi chuny malit."
To nowachonigi niya, "Ang'o momiyo ne umanya? Ok ung'eyo ni onego abed e od Wuora?"
To ne ok giwinjo tiend gima owachonigigo.
Eka nodhiyo gigo nyaka Nazareth, kendo ne omiyo gi luor. To minne nokano wechego duto e chunye.
Kendo Yesu nodongo e rieko, kendo e dongo mar ringruok, kendo e ng'wono kuom Nyasaye kod ji.
3: E higa mar apar gi abich mar loch Kaisar Tiberio, kane Pontio Pilato e jaloch mar Judea, Herode ne ruodh Galili, to owadgi Filipo ne ruodh piny Iturea gi Trakoniti, to Lusania ne ruodh Abilene,
e kinde dolo maduong' ma Anas gi Kaifa, wach Nyasaye ne obiro ni Johana wuod Zakaria e thim.
Nodhi e piny duto moluoro Jordan, koyalo batiso mar lokruok mar chuny ni weyruok richo.
kaka nondiki e kitabu mar weche mag Isaya janabi ni, "Duol mar ng'ato kok e thim kowacho ni, 'Ikuru yor Ruoth, rieyuru yorene tir.
Hoho duto nopong'i, kendo gode duto madongo gi matindo nodok piny; yore mobam nobed moriere tir, kendo yore motimo gogni nobed mayom;
kendo ji duto biro neno warruok mar Nyasaye.'"
Johana nowacho ni oganda mane biro mondo obatisgi ni, "Un nyithind thuonde! Ng'ano mane osiemou mondo uring uwe mirima mabiro?
Nyaguru olemo mowinjore gi lokruok. To kik uchak uwach kendu uwegi ni, 'Wan gi Ibrahim kaka wuonwa.' Nimar awachonu ni, Nyasaye nyalo loko kitegi mondo obed nyithind Ibrahim.
Le oseketi e tiend yiende, to yien moro amora maok nyag olemo maber ibiro ng'olo igo piny kendo iwito e mach."
Oganda nopenje ni, "To wan, onego watim ang'o?"
Nodwokogi ni, "Ng'at man gi law ariyo owinjore ochiw achiel ni jal ma ongego, kendo jalno man gi chiemo bende onego otim kamano."
Josol osuru bende nobiro mondo obatisgi, to negipenje ni, "Japuonj, wan to onego watim ang'o?"
Nonyisogi ni, "Kik usol osuru maduong' moloyo gima ne ochung'nuni."
Eka askeche moko bende nopenje ni, "To wan, onego watim ang'o?" Nodwokogi ni, "Kik uya ng'ato kata donjo ne ji gi miriambo, to musara maru muyudo mondo oromu."
Ji ne pod rito gi geno ahinya, kendo giduto ne giparo e chunygi kuom Johana ka be dipo ni en e Kristo.
Johana nodwoko ji duto ni, "An abatisou gi pi. To ng'ato man gi teko maloya biro, ma tond wuochege ok awinjora gonyo. En obiro batisou gi Roho Maler to gi mach.
Rapiedhi nie lwete mondo opiedhgo cham duto maler e kar dino cham, kendo ochok ngano oket e deche, to obiro wang'o mihudhi gi mach maok nyal neg."
Kendo gi weche moko mang'eny Johana nojiwo ji kendo noyalo Wach Maber ni ji.
To kane Johana okwero Herode ruodh piny nikech Herodia, ma chi owadgi, kendo kuom gik mamoko maricho duto mane Herode osetimo,
Herode nomedo richo moro achiel kuom mako Johana kendo tweye e jela.
Kane ibatiso ji duto, Yesu bende ne obatis. To kane olamo, polo ne oyawore,
kendo Roho Maler nolor kuome mopiyo machal gi akuru; to dwol ne owuok e polo mawacho niya, "In e Wuoda ma ahero; chunya mor kodi."
Koro ka Yesu owuon ne romo kar higni piero adek kane ochako tichne. Ne iparo ni en wuod Josef, wuod Eli,
wuod Mathat, wuod Lawi, wuod Melki, wuod Janai, wuod Josef,
wuod Matathia, wuod Amos, wuod Nahum, wuod Esli, wuod Nagai,
wuod Maath, wuod Matathia, wuod Semein, wuod Josek, wuod Joda,
wuod Joanan, wuod Resa, wuod Zerubabel, wuod Shealtiel, wuod Neri,
wuod Melki, wuod Adi, wuod Kosam, wuod Elmadam, wuod Er,
wuod Joshua, wuod Eliezer, wuod Jorim, wuod Mathat, wuod Lawi,
wuod Simeon, wuod Juda, wuod Josef, wuod Jonam, wuod Eliakim,
wuod Melea, wuod Mena, wuod Matatha, wuod Nathan, wuod Daudi,
wuod Jesse, wuod Obed, wuod Boaz, wuod Salmon, wuod Nashon,

4: Yesu, kopong’ gi Roho Maler, noa Jordan, kendo notelne gi Roho e thim.
kuma ne itemee gi Jachien kuom ndalo piero ang’wen. E ndalogo duto ne ok ochamo gimoro, kendo bang’ ndalogo koserumo, kech ne kaye.
Satan nowachone ni, “Ka in Wuod Nyasaye, nyis kidini olokre kuon.”
Yesu noduoke ni, “Ondiki ni, ‘Dhano ok bed mangima kuom kuon kende.’ ”
Eka Satan notere kama oting’ore malo, kendo ka diemo wang’ nono nonyise pinje ruodhi duto mag piny.
To nowachone niya, “Abiro miyi lochgi duto gi duong’gi, nimar osemiyagi, kendo anyalo chiwogi ni ng’ato ang’ata madwaro.
Emomiyo ka igoyo chongi nyima mondo ilama, magi duto biro bedo magi.”
Yesu noduoke ni, “Ondiki ni, ‘Lam Ruoth Nyasachi, kendo en kende ema itine.’ ”
Eka Satan notere Jerusalem, kendo nomiyo ochungo e osuch kama bor malo mar Hekalu. Eka nowachone ni, “Ka in Wuod Nyasaye, dirri piny kia ka,
nimar ondiki ni, ‘Obiro chiko malaikage kuomi, mondo oriti maber,’
kendo ni, ‘Giniting’i e lwetegi, mondo kik ichwany tiendi e kidi.’ ”
Yesu noduoke ni, “Owachi ni, ‘Kik item Ruoth Nyasachi.’ ”
Kane Satan osetieko temgi duto, noweye nyaka thuolo moro machielo.
Yesu nodok Galili e teko mar Roho, kendo wachne nolandore e gwenge duto mag aluora.
Nopuonjo e sunagogegi, kendo ji duto nopake.
Nodhiyo Nazareth kuma nopidhee, kendo chieng’ Sabato nodhiyo e sunagogi, kaka nobedo kite, kendo nochungo mondo osom.
Nomiye kitap Isaya janabi. Ka oelo kitabu, noyudo kama nondikie ni:
“Roho mar Ruoth ni kuoma, nikech osewira mondo ayal wach maber ne joma odhier. Oseora mondo aland ni joma otwe ni gin thuolo, kendo ni muofni ni oyaw wengegi, mondo ogony jogo misando,
kendo lando higa mar ng’wono mar Ruoth.”
Eka noumo kitabu, kendo nochiwe ni jatich, mine obedo piny. Wenge ji duto mane ni e sunagogi nong’iye matek.
To nochako kowachonigi niya, “Kawuono ndiko ni ochopo kare ka uwinjo.”
Ji duto nowuoyo maber kuome, kendo negiwuoro ahinya weche mag ng’wono manowuok e dhoge. Negipenjo ni, “Mani donge wuod Josef?”
Yesu nowachonigi ni, “Adier chutho ubiro wachona ngero ni, ‘In Jathieth, changri iwuon!’ kendo ni, ‘Tim e dalau ka bende gigo masewinjo ni ne itimo Kapernaum.’ ”
Nodhiyo nyime kowacho, “Awachonu adiera, onge janabi mirwako e dalane owuon.
Adier awachonu ni ne nitie mond liete mang’eny e Israel e kinde mar Elija, kane polo olor kuom higini adek gi nus kendo ne nitie kech mager e piny kuonde duto.
To kata kamano, ne ok oor Elija ir moro kata achiel kuomgi, to mak mana chi liel e dala mar Zarefath e gweng’ Sidon.
Bende ne nitie ji mang’eny e Israel mane nigi dhoho e kinde mar Elisha janabi, to onge kata achiel kuomgi mane opwodhi, mak mana Naaman kende, ja-Siria.”
Ji duto mane ni e sunagogi mirima mager nomakogi kane giwinjo wechego.
Ne gia malo, mine giriebe gigole oko mar taon, kendo tere e geng’ got kama nogerie taon-no, mondo gidhire piny kathirathira.
Kata kamano, nowuotho akadha kokadho e kindgi, kendo odhiyo.
Eka nodhiyo Kapernaum, taon manie Galili, kendo chieng’ Sabato nochako puonjo ji.
Negiwuoro puonjne, nikech wechene ne nigi teko.
To e sunagogi ne nitie ng’ato moro mane nigi chuny mar jachien, kendo noywak kogoyo koko matek niya,
“En ang’o midwaro timo kodwa, Yesu ja-Nazareth? Isebiro mondo itiekwa? Ang’eyo ng’at man in, in Ng’at Maler mar Nyasaye!”
Yesu nokwere matek niya, “Ling’ thi, kendo wuog ia kuome!” Eka jachien nogoyo ng’atno piny e nyimgi duto, kendo nowuok maok ohinye.
To ji duto nowuoro kendo ne giwachore e kindgi giwegi ni, “Ma wach mane? Gi teko kod loch ochiko chunje maricho, kendo giwuok!”
To wachne ne olandore kuonde duto mag aluorano.
Yesu noa e sunagogi kendo nodhiyo e od Simon. Koro mar Simon ne tuo midhusi matek, kendo negikwayo Yesu mondo okonye.
Omiyo nodhiyo mokulore bute, kendo nochiko midhusino, kendo midhusino noweye. Gikanyono nochungo, kendo nochako miyogi chiemo.
Kane chieng’ podho, ji duto mane nigi jomatuo mag tuoche mopogore opogore ne gikelogi ir Yesu; kendo noketo lwetene kuom ng’ato ka ng’ato kuomgi, mochangogi.
Bende jochiende ne wuok kuom ji mang’eny, kagoyo koko kowacho ni, “In e Wuod Nyasaye!” To nokwerogi, kendo ne ok oyie negi mondo giwuo, nikech neging’eyo ni en e Kristo.
Kane piny oru, Yesu nodhiyo kama wele kende. Oganda ne manye, kendo kane gibiro kama ne entie, negitemo tame mondo kik owegi.
To nowachonigi niya, “Nyaka ayal wach maber mar Pinyruoth Nyasaye e taonde moko bende, nikech mano e momiyo oora.”
Kendo nodhiyo nyime koyalo e sunagogi mag Judea.
5: Chieng’ moro achiel, ka Yesu nochungo but nam mar Genesaret, kendo ji ochokore moluore mondo giwinj wach Nyasaye,
Noneno yiedhi ariyo e dho wath, mane owe kanyo gi jolupo mane lwoko tondegi.
Nodonjo ei achiel mag yiedhigo, achiel mane mar Simon, mi nokwaye mondo okwang’e matin oa e dho wath. Eka nobedo piny kendo puonjo ji ka enie yie.
Kane osetieko wuoyo, nowacho ne Simon ni, "Kiew yie odhi e chuny pi kamatut, mondo uchik tondeu omak rech."
Simon nodwoke, "Ruoth, wasetiyo matek otieno mangima to ok wasemako gimoro. To nikech iwacho kamano, abiro chiko tonde."
Kane gisetimo kamano, ne gimako rech mang’eny ma koro tondegi ne chako yiech.
Kuom mano, ne giggulo jowetegi mane nie yie machielo mondo obi okonygi, to kane gibiro ne gipong’o yiedhi ariyogo mopong’ thich ma koro ne gichako nimo.
Kane Simon Petro oneno mani, nopodho e tiend Yesu, mowacho niya, "Dhiyo iaa kuoma Ruoth, an ng’at ma jaricho!"
Nimar en kaachiel gi joma ne engo duto nowuoro nikech rech mane gimako,
Kamano bende, Jakobo gi Johana, yawuot Zebedi, mane jotiyo gi Simon bende nowuoro. Eka Yesu nowacho ni Simon niya, "Kik iluor; chakre tinendeni ibiro bedo jaywa ji."
Kuom mano, ne giketo yiegi oko e dho wath, ne giweyo gik moko duto kendo ne giluwe.
Kane Yesu nie taon achiel moro, ng’ato nobiro ma dhoho omako dende duto; kane oneno Yesu, nopodho piny ka okulore e lowo kendo nosaye ni, "Ruoth, ka iyie, inyalo miyo abed maler."
Yesu norieyo lwete momulo ng’atno, nowachone niya, "Ayie. Bed maler!" Gikanyono dhoho noa kuome.
Eka Yesu nochike ni, "Kik inyis ng’ato, to dhiyo, mondo inyisri iwuon e nyim jadolo kendo ichiw misengini ma Musa nochiko nikech puodhruokni, mondo obed ranyisi ne gin."
To kata kamano humbe nomedo landore moloyo, momiyo oganda mag ji mang’eny nobiro winje kendo mondo ochang tuochegi.
To Yesu ne thoro dhiyo kuonde machil ma en kende mondo olem.
Chieng’ moro kane opuonjo, Jofarisai gi jopuonj mag Chik, mane oa e mier duto mag Galili gi Judea kod Jerusalem, nobedo kanyo. To teko mar Ruoth ne nikode mondo ochang jotuo.
Ji moko nobiro koting’o jathany e par, kendo negitemo mondo gitere ei ot mondo gikele e nyim Yesu.
To kane ok ginyal yudo yo mar timo kamano nikech oganda, negiidho e wi tado kendo gipowo wi tado, eka negilore e pare e dier oganda e nyim Yesu.
Kane Yesu oneno yiegi, nowacho niya, "Osiepa, richoni oweni."
Jofarisai gi jopuonj mag Chik nochako paro e chunygi giwegi ni, "Mani to ng’ano ma wacho wach marach kuom Nyasaye? Ng’ano manyalo weyo richo mak mana Nyasaye kende?"
Yesu nong’eyo gima giparo, kendo nopenjogi ni, "Ang’o momiyo uparo gigi e chunyu?"
Ere mayot wacho, 'Richoni oweni,' koso wacho ni, 'Chung’ kendo iwuothi'?
To mondo omi ung’e ni Wuod Dhano nigi teko e piny mar weyo richo... Nowacho ni jathany ni, "Awacho ni, chung’, kaw pari kendo idhi dala."
Gikanyono nochungo e nyimgi duto, okawgo mane opieerego, kendo nodhiyo dala kopako Nyasaye.
Ji duto nowuoro kendo negichiwo pak ni Nyasaye. Negiwuoro ahinya kendo negiwacho ni, "Waseneno gik malich kawuono."
Bang’ mani, Yesu nowuok odhi oko kendo noneno jasol osuru ma nyinge Lawi kobedo kar choko osuru. Yesu nowachone ni, "Luwa."
To Lawi noa malo, mowe yo gik moko duto kendo noluwe.
Eka Lawi noloso nyasi mar rwak ni Yesu e ode, oganda maduong’ mar josol osuru kaachiel gi ji mamoko nechiemo kodgi.
To Jofarisai gi jopuonj mag Chik mag dinigi ne ng’ur ni jopuonjrene ni, "Ang’o momiyo uchiemo kendo metho gi josol osuru kod joricho?"
Yesu nodwokogi ni, "Ok jomangima ema dwaro jathieth, to jomatuo."
Ok asebiro mondo aluong jomakare, to mana joricho mondo gilokre."
Negiwachone ni, "Jopuonjre Johana ne thoro tueyo chiemo kendo lamo, to bende jopuonjre mag Jofarisai timo kamano, to magi dhiyo mana nyime gi chiemo kendo metho."
Yesu nodwoko ni, "Bende inyalo miyo wend wuon kisera otwe chiemo ka en kodgi?"
To ndalo biro biro ma wuon kisera nogol kuomgi, e ndalogo gibiro tueyo chiemo.
Eka nogoyonigi ngeroni ni, "Onge ng’ama nyalo yiecho dir law manyien kendo otwang’e kuom mano moti. Ka otimo kamano, obiro bedo ni oyiecho law manyien, to dir law manyien ok bi winjore kod machon."
Bende onge ng’ama olo divai manyien e ndede moti. Ka otimo kamano, divai manyien biro yiecho ndedego, divai biro pukore kendo ndede biro kethore.
Ooyo, divai manyien nyaka olie e ndede manyien.
To onge ng’ama bang’ madho divai machon dwaro divai manyien, owacho ni, "machon ber moloyo."
6: Chieng’ Sabato moro, Yesu nowuotho e puothe mag ngano, kendo jopuonjrene nochako jako wi ngano, negi dunyogi e lwetegi mi gichamo ngano.
Jofarisai moko nopenjo ni, "Ang’o momiyo utimo gima chik okwero chieng’ Sabato?"
Yesu nodwokogi niya, "Pok ne usomo gima Daudi notimo kaachiel gi jogo mane ni kode ka kech nekayogi?
Nodonjo e od Nyasaye, kendo nokawo makati miketo e nyim Nyasaye, nochamo gima chik oyie ni jodolo kende ema chamo. Kendo nochiwo moko ne jogo mane ni kode."
Eka Yesu nowachonigi niya, "Wuod Dhano en Ruodh Sabato."
Chieng’ Sabato machielo nodhiyo ei sunagogi kendo nopwonjo, to ng’ato neni kanyo ma lwete korachwich notal.
Jofarisai kod Jopuonj mag Chik ne dwaro gimoro ma dimi gidonjnego Yesu, omiyo ne ging’iyogo machiegni, mondo gine ka dochang’ chieng’ Sabato.
To Yesu nong’eyo gima negiparo, eka nowacho ni ng’atno mane lwete otal ni, "Aa malo kendo chungi e nyim ji duto." Kamano noa malo mi ochungo kanyo.
Eka Yesu nowachonigi niya, "Apenjou, ere gima owinjore gi chik chieng’ Sabato, timo maber koso timo marach, reso ngima koso kethe?"
Norangogi duto, to eka nowacho ni ng’atno niya, "Rie lweti oko." Notimo kamano, to lwete nochango chutho.
To negikecho kendo negichako wuoyo ng’ato gi ng’ato kuom gino ma digitim ni Yesu.
Chieng’ moro achiel Yesu nowuok modhi mo kare gi got mondo olem, kendo nobedo otieno mangima kolamo Nyasaye.
Kane okinyi ochopo, noluongo jopuonjrene ire kendo noyiero apar gariyo kuomgi, mane owalo obedo joote:
Simon (mane omiyo nying ni Petro); gi owadgi Andrea, Jakobo, Johana, Filipo, Batholomayo,
Mathayo, Thoma, Jakobo wuod Alfayo, Simon mane iluongo ni Jakedo ni piny,
Juda wuod Jakobo, gi Juda Ja-Iskariot, mane obedo jandhok.
Nolor kodgi piny kendo nochungo kama opie. Oganda maduong’ mar jopuonjrene ne nikanyo to kod ji mang’eny moa kuonde duto mag Judea, moa Jerusalem, kendo moa e dho nam mar Turo gi Sidon,
mano biro mondo giwinje kendo ochang midekregi. Jogo mane jochiende thago nochangi,
To ji duto notemo mondo omule, nikech teko ne aa kuome kendo changogi duto.
Ko-ng’iyo jopuonjrene, nowacho niya, "Un joma ogwedh, jogo modhier, nimar piny Ruoth Nyasaye en maru.
Un joma ogwedhi joma kech kayo koroni, nimar ubiro yieng’. Un joma ogwedhi joma ywak koroni, nimar ubiro nyiero.
Un jogo megwedhi ka ji himou, ka gikwedou kendo jarou kendo gidagi nyingu ka rach, nikech Wuod Dhano.
Beduru mamor e ndalono kendo chikreuru ka uil, nikech poku duong’ e polo. Nimar mano e kaka kweregi notimo ni jonabi.
To okuong’u un jomwandu, nimar useyudo poku.
Okuong’u un jomayieng’ maber e kindeni, nimar ubiro bedo modenyo. Okuong’u un jogo manyiero koroni, nimar ubiro kuyo kendo ywak.
Okuong’u ka ji duto wuoyo maber kuomu, nimar mano e kaka kweregi notimoni jonabi ma jomiriambo.
To owachonu un joma mawinja ni: Heruru wasigu, timuru maber ni joma mamon kodu.
Guedhuru joma kuong’ou, lamuru ni joma sandou.
Ka ng’ato caring’o lembi konchiel, to lokne komachielo bende. Ka ng’ato okawo koti ni, kik itame kawo sadi.
Miuru ji duto makwayou, to ka ng’ato okawo gimoro mari, kik idwar ni mondo oduoknigo.
Timuru ni ji mamoko mana kaka duher mondo gin bende gitimnu.
Ka uhero joma oherou, en ohala manadi kuomu? Nimar kata joricho ohero mana joma oherogi.
To ka utimo maber ni joma timonu maber, en ohala manadi kuomu? Kata mana joricho timo kamano.
To ka uholo mana joma un gi adier ni biro dwokonu, en ohala manadi kuomu? Kata mana joricho holo mana joricho ka gigeno ni ibiro chulogi duto.

To heruru wasigu, timnegiuru maber, kendo holgiuru ka ok ugeno ni ubiro yudo gimoro bang’e. Eka poku biro bedo maduong’ kendo ubiro bedo yawuot Ng’ama Malo moloyo, nikech ong’won ni jogo ma ok go erokamano kendo jomaricho.
Beduru mang’won, mana kaka Wuoru ng’won.
Kik ung’ad bura, kendo bende ok bi ng’adnu bura. Kik ukuong’ ji, to ok bi kuong’u. Weuru ni ji richogi, to ibiro weyonu richou.
Chiwuru, to ibiro chiwonu. Ubiro yudo rapim maber, moiki kendo motiel mapong’ thich, kendo oo oko. Nimar rapim ma utiyogo, mano bende ema nopimnugo.
Nogoyo nigi ngeroni bende ni: "Ng’at mamuofu bende nyalo telo ni ng’at mamuofu? Donge giduto ji ariyogo diling’re ei bugo?"
Japuonjre ok duong’ moloyo japuonjne, to ng’ato ka ng’ato motiegi chuth biro bedo machal gi japuonjne.
En ang’o momiyo ineno mana pilni yath manie wang’ owadu, to yath manie wang’i iwuon to ok idewa?

Ere kaka diwach ni owadu ni, "Owadwa, yie mondo agol pil yath manie wang’i," ka in iwuon ok inyal neno yath manie wang’i iwuon? In jawuondre, mokwongo gol yadhono oko manie wang’i, to eka ibiro neno maler mondo igol pil yadhno manie wang’ owadu.
Onge yath maber manyago olemo maricho, kata yath marach manyago olemo maber.
Yath ka yath ing’eyo kod olembe owuon. Ji ok pon ng’ou kuom yiende mag kudho, kata mzabibu bende ok pon kuom otonglo.
Ng’at maber golo gik mabeyo mawuok e keno maber ei chunye, to ng’at marach golo gik maricho mawuok e keno marach manie chunye. Nimar gik mopong’o chunye dhoge wacho.
Ang’o momiyo uluonga ni, "Ruoth, Ruoth," to ok utim gima awacho?
Abiro nyisou kaka ng’atno chalo, jalno mabiro ira kendo winjo wachna, kendo otimogi.
Ochalo gi ng’at magero ot, manokunyo bur matut nyaka e lwanda kendo noketo e mise; kane koth ochue ma pi opong’o piny, apaka mogingore nogoyo odno to ne ok onyal yienge, nikech nogere maber.
To jal mawinjo wechena to ok otimgi chalo gi ng’at manogero ot e wi lowo maonge gi mise; e kindeno ma apaka mogingore nogoyo odno, nogore piny kendo nokethore chuth.
7: Kane Yesu osetieko wacho wechegi duto e nyim ji mane winjo, nodonjo Kapernaum.
To jatich jaduong' lweny moro, mane ruodhe ogene ahinya, ne tuo kendo nochiegni gi tho.
Jaduong' lweny nowinjo humb Yesu, omiyo nooro jodongo mag Joyahudi ire, mondo gikwaye obi ochang jatichne.
Kane gibiro ir Yesu, negisaye chutho kawacho ni, "Ng'atni owinjore mondo itimne mani,"
"nikech ohero pinywa kendo osegeronwa sunagogi."
Kuom mano, Yesu nodhiyo kodgi. Ne ok en mabor gi ot kane jaduong' lweny nooro osiepene mondo owachne ni, "Ruoth, kik ichandri, nikech ok awinjora ibi idonji e bwo tat oda."
"Mani e momiyo ok asekwanora ni awinjora biro iri. To wach weche matin to jatichna biro chango."

"Nimar awuon an ng'at manie bwo loch, kendo an gi askache manie bwoya. Ka awacho ni ng'at achiel ni, 'Dhi,' to odhiyo, kendo ni machielo ni, 'Bi,' to obiro. Awacho ni jatichna ni, 'Tim ma,' to otime."
Kane Yesu owinjo wechegi nowuore, kendo kane olokore ir oganda maluwe, nowacho ni, "Awachonu, pok ayudo yie maduong' kama kata e Israel."
Eka jogo mane ooor nodok e ot, negiyudo jatich kangima.
Mapiyo bang' mano, Yesu nodhiyo e taon miluongo ni Nain, to jopuonjrene gi oganda maduong' bende nodhi kode.
Kaka nosudo machiegni gi dhoranga taon, ng'at motho noting' gigolo oko, wuowi achiel kende wuod min, to en dhako ma chi liel. To oganda maduong' moa e taon neni kode.
Kane Ruoth nene, chunye nokeche kendo nowachone ni, "Kik iywagi."
Eka nodhiyo machiegni kendo nomulo sanduku mane oting'ee wuowi manotho, to jogo mane oting'e nochungo. Nowacho ni, "Wuowi matin, awachoni, chungi aa malo!"
Ng'at mothono nobedo piny kendo nochako wuoyo, to Yesu nodwoke momiye min.
Gin duto luoro nomakogi kendo negipako Nyasaye. Negiwacho ni, "Janabi maduong' osewuok e dierwa!" Kendo ni, "Nyasaye osebiro konyo joge."
Wach maber ni mar Yesu nolandore e Judea mangima kod piny molwore.
Jopuonjre Johana nonyise wechegi duto. Omiyo Johana noluongo ji ariyo kuom jopuonjrene,
ne oorogi ir Ruoth mondo gipenje ni, "In e jalno mane biro koso onego wagen ng'at moro machielo?"
Ka jogo nobiro ir Yesu, negiwacho ni, "Johana Jabatiso noorowa iri mondo wapenji ni, 'In e jal mane biro, koso wagen ng'ato moro machielo?'"
E saa nogono Yesu nochango ji mang'eny manenigi tuoche, midekre kod chunje maricho, kendo nomiyo muofni mang'eny mondo onen.

Kamano nodwokogi ni, "Doguru kendo unyis Johana gik mauseneno kendo winjo: muofni neno, rong'onde wuotho, jogo mang'eyo dhoho ichango, joma itgi odinore winjo, jomatho ichiero, kendo wach maber iyalo ni jochan."
"En ng'at mogwedhi jal maok chwanyre mabar nikech an."
Bang'e ka jopuonjre Johana nosea odhi, Yesu nochako wuoyo ni oganda kuom Johana ni: "Ang'o mane udhiyo e thim mondo une? Odundu ma yamo yienge?"
"Ka ok mano, en ang'o mane udhi mondo une? Ng'at morwakore gi lewni mabeyo? Ooyo, jogo marwako lewni manengogi tek kendo madhialore gi gik mabeyo nie ute ruodhi."
"To un nudhi mondo une ang'o? Janabi? Ee, Awachonu, kendo mana moloyo janabi."
"Mani e jal mane ondik kuome ni: 'Abiro oro jaotena motelo nyimi, mabiro loso yori motelo ni.'"
"Awachonu, kuom jogo ma mon onyuolo onge ng'ato maduong' moloyo Johana; kata kamano jalo matinie moloyo e piny Ruoth Nyasaye duong' moloye."
Ji duto, kata mana jasol osuru, kane giwinjo weche Yesu, negiyie ni yor Nyasaye ni kare, nikech nosebatisgi gi Johana.
To Jofarisai kod jogo molonye chik nodagi dwaro mar Nyasaye kuomgi giwegi, nikech nepok obatisgi gi Johana.
"Koro ere gima dapimgo ji mar tieng' ma kawuononi? Gichalo gi ang'o?"
"Gichalo nyithindo mobedo e chiro kendo luongore kendgi moro ka moro ni: 'Nende wagoyonu thum, to ok ne umiel; bende ka wagoyonu nduru, to ne ok uywak.'"
"Nimar Johana Jabatiso ne obiro maok ocham makati kata madho divai, to uwacho ni, 'En gi jachien.'"
"Wuod Dhano nobiro kachiemo kendo metho, to uwacho ni, 'Maeri jawuoro kendo jamer, osiep josol osuru duto kendo joricho.'"
"To rieko ofweny adimba gi nyithindo duto."
Koroni Jafarisai achiel moro noluongo Yesu mondo ochiem kode, nodhiyo e od Jafarisai mobedo but mesa.
Kane dhako mane osedak e ngima mar richo e dalano nowinjo ni Yesu ne chiemo e od Jafarisai, nokelo chupa mar alabasta mar mo mang'ue ng'ar,
kendo nochungo e toke, but tiende. Pi wang'e nolwar e tiendege ma gitimo pi, eka noyueyogi gi yie wiye, monyo dhogi kendo noolo mo kuomgi.
Kane Jafarisai mane oluonge oneno ma, nowacho e chunye ni, "Kada ng'atni en janabi, da ong'eyo jal mamuleni kendo ni en dhako machalo nadi, ni en jaricho."
Yesu nodwoke ni, "Simon, an-gi gima adwaro wachoni." Nowachone ni, "Wachna, Japuonj."
"Ji ariyo ne nigi gop jahol pesa moro. Achiel ne gope mar siling' mia abich, to machielo piero abich."
"Giduto ji ariyogi ne gionge gi pesa magichulego, omiyo nowe weyonigi gopegi. Koro en mane kuomgi mabiro here moloyo?"
Simon nodwoke ni, "Aparo ni jalno mane nigi gowi maduong' mowe ne." Yesu nowacho ni, "Isedwoko kare."
Eka nolokore mong'iyo dhakono mowacho ni Simon, "Ineno dhakoni? Nabiro odi. Ne ok imiya pi moro amora mondo alwokgo tiendena, to nolwoko tiendena gi pi wang'e kendo noyueyogi gi yie wiye."
"To in ne ok inyodha, to dhakoni chakre saa mane adonjo, ne ok oweyo nyodho tiendena."
"Ne ok iolo mo e wiya, to oseolo mo mang'ue ng'ar e tiendena."
"Emomiyo, awachoni, richone mathoth owene – nikech nohero mathoth. To jal mowene matin, ohero matin."
Eka Yesu nowachone ni, "Richoni oweni."
Welo mamoko nochako wacho kendgi giwegi ni, "Mani en ng'a ma weyo niji richogi?"
Yesu nowacho ni dhakono ni, "Yieni oseresi; dhi gi kuwe."
8: Bang’ mano, Yesu newuotho koa e taon ka taon kod gweng’ ka gweng’ ka olando wach maber mar Piny Ruoth Nyasaye. Jopuonjrene apar gariyo ne ni kode,
kaachiel gi mine moko mane osegol kuomgi jochiende kendo ochang tuochegi kaka Maria (mane iluongo ni Magdala) mane jochiende abiriyo osewuok kuome;
Joana chi Kuza, mane jatelo e od Herode gi Susana kod mon mamoko mathoth. Mon-gi ne konyogi ka gichiwonegi gigegi giwegi.
Ka noyudo oganda maduong’ chokore kendo ji ne biro ire moa e taon ka taon nogoyo negi ngeroni:
"Japur nodhi chuoyo kodhi. Ka noyudo nokiro kodhi, moko nolwar e yo mi nonyongi kendo winy nochamogi.
Moko nolwar ewi lwanda mine giti kendo neginer nikech negionge kod ng’ich.
Kodhi moko nolwar e dier kudho, mane odongo kode kendo nothung’ cham.
Bende kodhi moro nolwar e lowo maber. Noti kendo nonyago cham, nyadi mia moloyo kaka ne ochuoye. Ka nowacho ma, nogoyo koko ni, 'Ng’at man-gi ite mawinjo, mondo owinji.'"
Jopuonjre nopenje gima ngerono nyiso.
Nowacho ni, "Ng’eyo mar gik mopondo mag Piny Ruoth Nyasaye osemiu, to ji mamoko awuoyo nigi gi ngerini, omiyo, kata ging’icho, to ok ginyal neno, kendo kata giwinjo, to ok nyal donjonigi."
"Ma e gima ngeroni nyiso: Kodhi en wach Nyasaye.
Molwar e yo gin jogo mawinjo, to jachien biro kendo golo wach ei chunygi, mondo kik giyie mi owargi.
Molwar e lwanda gin jogo marwako wach gi mor ka giwinje, to gionge gi tiende. Giyie kuom kinde moromo, to e kinde mag tem gipodho giaa.
Kodhi molwar e dier kudho ochungo kar jogo mawinjo, to ka gidhiyo e yorgi, to parruok mar ngima, mwandu kod mor mar piny thung’ogi, ma ok gidong’ motegno.
To kodhi manie lowo maber, ochungo kar jogo man gi chuny malong’o kendo maber, mawinjo wach, okane, kendo bedo modhil onyago cham."
"Onge ng’ato mamoko taya kendo pande ei sufuria kata kete e bwo otanda. Kar timo kamano, to okete ewi rachungi taya, mondo jogo madonjo one ler.
Nimar onge gimoro mopando maok bi elore, kendo onge gima oum maok nong’ere kata bedo e lela.
Emomiyo paruru ahinya maber kaka uwinjo. Ng’at man-go nomedne moko; ng’at maongego, kata mano moparo ni en-go ibiro maye."
Koro min Yesu gi owetene nobiro mondo ginene, to ne ok ginyal sudo machiegni kode nikech oganda.
Ng’at moro nowachone ni, "Meru gi oweteni ochungo oko, gidwaro neni."
Nodwoko ni, "Mamana kod owetena gin jogo mawinjo wach Nyasaye kendo timo."
Kiny moko, Yesu nodonjo e yie gi jopuonjrene, mi nowachonegi ni, "Wakuadhuru loka nam loka cha." Omiyo ne gichako wuoth.
Ka giluoko yie, nindo nonepe. Yamb auka maduong’ ne ogoyo e nam, mi pi ne odonjo e yie, mi ne gichiegni lwar e ratiro.
Ne gichulo Yesu mi gichiewe, ka giwacho ni, "Ruoth, Ruoth, walal!" Nochiewo mi okwero yamo kod mape mapi, mi yambne notho mi piny noding’ motegno.
Nopenjogi ni, "Yieno maru koro ni kure?" Giluor ne omakogi kendo gihum, mi ne giwachore e kindgi giwegi ni, "Ng’at ma en ng’ano maratiro, machiko kata mana yamo gi pi kendo giwinjo wachne?"
Ne giluoko yie nyaka e piny Jo-Gerasa, mantie loka nam machiegni gi Galili.
Ka Yesu olor e lowo, ng’at moro moa e dhoot mane nigi jochiende ne bironi ire. Kuom kinde malach ne ok oruako nang’a kendo ne ok odag e ot, to nodag mana e liel.
Ka neno Yesu, nogoyo ngero, mi ogore piny e nyime, kendo owacho gi dwol maduong’ ni, "An gi wach mane kodi, Yesu, Wuod Nyasaye Malo Chutho? Asayi, kik isandna!"

Nimar Yesu nosechiko chuny marachno mondo owuog kuom ng’atno. Nyadi thoth chuny marachno ne make, kata ka negitweyego nyororo mag chuma e lwetene kod tiendene kendo rito gi jolwenj, ne oturo nyororogo, mi jachien ne dhiye kode e laro.
Yesu nopenje ni, "Nyingi ng’ano?" Nodwoko ni, "Lijon," nikech jochiende mathoth ne odonjo kuome.
Kendo ne gisaye ahinya mondo kik ochikgi dhi e bugo man-gi tut maonge giko.
Kanyo ne nitie kweth maduong’ mar mbeche manyitho cham ewi got. Jochiendego ne gisayo Yesu mondo oyie negi donjo kuom mbechego, kendo noyie negi.
Ka jochiende osewuok kuom ng’atno, ne gidonjo kuom mbeche, kendo kwethno noringo piny gi ng’ech piny e wi lwanda, mi gipodhne e nam, kendo negitho e pi.
Ka jorith mbechego neno gima otimore, ne giringo mi gilando wachno e taon kod e gweng’.
Ji nowuok dhi neno gima osebiro timore. Ka ne gibiro ir Yesu, ne giyudo ng’at mane jochiende owuok kuome, obet piny e tiend Yesu, koruako nang’a kendo e chunye malong’o, mi ne giluor.
Jogo mane oneno gima otimore ne lando negi kaka ng’at mane nigi jochiende ne ochangi.
Ji duto ma gweng’ Jo-Gerasa kanyo ne osayo Yesu mondo owuog e pinygi, nikech luoro maduong’ ne omakogi. Omiyo nodonjo e yie mi nodok.
Ng’at mane jochiende owuok kuome ne osaye mondo odhi kode. To Yesu ne ogole ka owachone ni,
"Dog dalau, kendo ipepe gima Nyasaye osetimoni." Omiyo nodhi, ka olando e taon duto gima Yesu osetimone.
Ka Yesu noduogo, oganda duto ne orwake gi mor, nikech duto ne girito biro ne.
Kanyo, ng’at moro miluongo ni Jairo, jatend sunagogi, ne obiro mi ogore piny e tiend Yesu, ka osaye mondo obi e ode,
nikech nyarene ma miderma ma higni mare ne chiegni apar gariyo ne ngerni tho. Ka Yesu ne dhiye, oganda ne ithure kuom thothgi.
Kendo dhako moro mane nigi tuo mar chwer mar remo kuom higni apar gariyo, mane ok nyal chango gi ng’ato ang’ata (kata obedo ni ne osechamo mwandune duto kuom jothieth),
ne osudo bang’e, mi omulo tiend nang’ane; kendo gie sa no chwer mar remone ne ochokore.
Yesu nopenjo ni, "Ng’ano mamula?" Ka duto ne gikwedo, Petero nowacho ni, "Ruoth, oganda osudo kendo ithuri."
To Yesu nowacho ni, "Ng’at moro omula, nimar ang’eyo ni teko owuok kuoma."
Ka dhakono noneno ni ok onyal pondo, ne obiro ka otitni, mi ogore piny e nyime. Kendo e nyim ji duto, ne olerne gima omiyo ne omulo Yesu, kendo kaka ne ochangi gie sa no.
Noyie ka owachone ni, "Nyara, yie mari osechango; dhi gi kuwe."
Ka podh owuoyo, ng’at moro ne obiro moa e od jatend sunagogi, ka owacho ni, "Nyari osetho; kik isand japuonj koro."
Ka Yesu owinjo mae, nodwoko Jairo ni, "Kik iluor; yie mana, kendo ibiro chango nyari."
Ka nodonjo e odno, ne ok oyie ng’ato ang’ata odonj kode, makmana Petero, Johana, kendo Jakobo, gi wuon nyako kendo minne.
Koro ji duto ne ywak kendo guyo ne nyakono. To Yesu nowacho ni, "Weuru ywak; ok otho to onindo aninda."
Ne ginyiere, nimar ne ging’eyo ni osetho.
To Yesu nomako lwetene, mi oluongo ni, "Nyako, chiew!"
Chunye noduogo, mi ochung’ mapiyo kendo Yesu nochiko mondo omiye chiemo.
Jonyuolne ne ohum ahinya, to Yesu nochikogi ahinya kik giwach ne ng’ato ang’ata gima otimore.
9: Kane Yesu oseluongo jopuonjre apar gariyo kaachiel, nomiyogi teko kod nyalo mar golo jochiende duto, kendo mar chango tuoche.
kendo noorogi mondo giyal piny ruoth Nyasaye, kendo gichang jomatuo.
Nowachonegi ni, "Kik uting' gimoro ka udhi e wuoth: kata luth, kata mbori, kata chiemo, kata pesa; kendo kik ubed gi lewni moko."
Ot moro amoro mudonjeie, ubed kanyo, nyaka ua e taondno.
Kendo ka ji ok orwakou, ka uwuok e taondno, uteng' buch tiendeu, kaka siem ne gin.
Kamano ne giwuok, madhi e gweng' ka gweng', ka giyalo Injili, kendo gichango ji kuonde duto.
Koro Herode ma ja-lochni nowinjo gik moko duto matimore, to noparore, nikech ji moko ne wacho ni Johana osechier kuom jomotho,
jo moko to ni Elija osefwenyore, to bende moko to ni achiel kuom jonabi machon osechier.
To Herode nowacho niya, "Johana ne aseng'ado wiye; koro ng'atni en ng'ano, ma awinjo gik machalo kamagi kuome?" Kendo notemo mondo onene.
Kane joote oduogo, ne ginyiso Yesu gigo duto mane gisetimo. Eka nokawogi, modhi kodgi kaachiel kar kendgi, e taon miluongo ni Bethsaida,
to oganda nowinjo mano, kendo ne giluwe; norwakogi, kendo nowuoyo kodgi kuom piny ruoth Nyasaye, kendo nochango jogo mane dwaro chango.

Kar seche mag odhiambo, jopuonjre apar gariyo nobiro ire, kendo negiwachone ni, "We oganda ji odoghi, mondo gidhi e mier machiegni kod gwenge, mondo giyud chiemo kod kuonde nindo, nikech wan ka e thim."
No-dwokogi ni, "Un, migiuru gima ginyalo chamo." Negidwoko niya, "Wan mana gi makati abich kod rech ariyo kende, mak mana ka wadhi wang'iewo chiemo ne ogandani duto."
Nimar ne nitie ji ma chwo madirom alufu abich. To nowacho ni jopuonjrene niya, "Nyisgiuru gibed piny e girube, moro ka moro ji piero abich."
Jopuonjre notimo kamano, kendo negimiyo giduto obedo piny.
Nokawo makati abich kod rech ariyogo, nong'iyo malo, ogoyo erokamano kuomgi, kendo nong'ingogi, nomiyogi jopuonjre mondo giket e nyim oganda.
Giduto negichiemo mi giyieng', kendo ne gichoko ng'injo mag chiemo mane odong' aditi apar gariyo mopong'.
Chieng' moro kane Yesu lemo kende, jopuonjre ne ni kode; nopenjogi ni, "Oganda wacho ni an ng'a?"
Negidwoko niya, "Moko wacho ni in Johana Jabatiso, to moko ni in Elija, to moko bende ni in achiel kuom jonabi machon mosechier."
Nopenjogi ni, "To un uwacho ni an ng'a?" Petro nodwoko ni, "In e Kristo mar Nyasaye."
Yesu nokwerogi matek kendo nochikogi mondo kik ginyis ng'ato ang'ata wachno;
kawacho ni, "Wuod Dhano nyaka sand matek, kendo joduong' jomadongo kod jodolo madongo kod jopuonj-chik biro kwede, kendo nyaka nege, to chieng' mar adek nochiere."
Eka nowachonigi duto ni, "Ka ng'ato moro dwaro luwa, nyaka okwedre owuon, oting' msalape ndalo duto, kendo oluwa."
Nimar ng'at madwaro reso ngimane nolale, to ng'at malalo ngimane kuoma, en e mabiro rese.
Nimar ere ber ma ng'ato yudo, ka oyudo piny duto, to olalo kata oketho ngimane owuon?
Ka ng'ato wiye okuot koda kod wechena, Wuod Dhano bende wiye biro kuot kode ka obiro e duong'ne, kendo e duong' mar Wuoro, kod mar malaike maler.
To awachonu adier ni, moko kuom joma ochungo ka ok nobil tho ngang' nyaka gineno piny ruoth Nyasaye.
Kar ndalo aboro bang' ka Yesu nosewacho wechego, nokawo Petro, Johana, kod Jakobo, kendo nodhiyo malo e wi got mondo olam.
To kane pod olemo, kit wang'e nolokore, kendo lepe nolokore matar kendo marieny.
Kendo, ne ng'ich, ji ariyo ne wuoyo kode, mapiyo gin Musa kod Elija,
mane ofwenyore e duong', mi giwuoyo kuom thone mane dhi chopo e Jerusalem.
To nindo ne oloyo Petro kod jowadgi; to kane gichiewo, ne gineno duong'ne, kod ji ariyogo mane ochungo kode.

To kane jogo dhi wuok kuome, Petro nowacho ne Yesu niya, "Jaduong', en gima ber ka wabedo ka; we mondo wager kiche adek, achiel mari, achiel mar Musa, kendo achiel mar Elija," nimar ne ok ong'eyo gima owacho.
Kane pod owuoyo kamano, bor polo nobiro moimogi; kendo ne giluor kane bor polono oumogi.
Kendo duol moro noa e bor polo, kawacho niya, "Ma e Wuoda maseyiero; winjeuru!"
Kane duolno osegoyee, ne giyudo ni Yesu ni kende. Jopuonjre nokano wechego e kindgi, kendo ne ok ginyiso ng'ato ang'ata e ndalo wechego gigo mane giseneno.
Kinyne, kane gilor gia e wi got, oganda maduong' noromone.
Ng'at moro e dier oganda noluongo matek niya, "Japuonj, akwayoi rang wuoda, nikech en nyathina achiel kende;"
kendo, ne ng'ich, jachien make, kendo ogoyo koko mapiyo ahinya; kendo ogoye piny koguecho oriere, mi dhoge wuok buoyo, kendo osando matek, ka ok dwa weye mapiyo.
Kendo ne akwayo jopuonjregi mondo giriembe oko, to ne ok ginyalo.
Yesu nodwoko niya, "Yaye, tieng' maonge yie kendo mobam, nyaka karang'o ma dabed kodu, kendo ma dachandra kodu? Kel wuodi ka."
Kata e kindeno mane wuowino pod biro, jachien nogoye piny, kendo oguecho marach. To Yesu nokwero jachien marachno, mi nochango wuowino, kendo nochiwe ne wuon mare.
Kendo giduto ne giwuoro duong' maduong' mar Nyasaye. To kane ji duto pod wuoro kuom gigo duto mane Yesu timo, nowachone jopuonjrene niya,
"Keturu wechegi e itu: ningo Wuod Dhano ibiro ndhogo e lwet ji."
To ne ok giwinjo tiend wachno, kendo ne opandonegi, mi ne ok ging'eyo tiende; kendo ne giluor penje kuom wachno.
Kendo mbaka nowuok e kindgi kuom ng'ama duong' moloyo kuomgi.
To kaka Yesu nong'eyo parogi, nokawo nyathi matin, mi nokete ochungo bute,
nowachonegi niya, "Ng'ato ang'ata morwako nyathi matinni e nyinga, orwaka; kendo ng'ama orwakoa, orwako jal manoora; nimar ng'at matin mogik kuomu duto, en e maduong'."
Johana nodwoko niya, "Jaduong', ne waneno ng'ato kariembo jochiende e nyingi, kendo ne watemo kwede, nikech ok oluwo korwa."
Yesu nowachone niya, "Kik ukwede; nimar ng'at maok mon kodu en jakoru."
Kane ndalo mogo mar tere malo e polo ochiegni chopo, Yesu noketo chunye motegno mondo odhi Jerusalem.
Eka nooro joote mondo otel nyime; mi ne gidhi, kendo ne gidonjo e dala moro mar Jo-Samaria, mondo goikne kuonde nindo.
To ne ok gorwake, nikech wang'e ne rito dhi Jerusalem.
Kane jopuonjre, Jakobo kod Johana oneno mano, ne gipenjo ni, "Ruoth, idwaro ni waluong mach oa e polo, mondo obi otiekgi?"
To Yesu nolokore, mi nokwerogi.
Eka ne gidhi e dala machielo.
Kane pod giwuotho e yo, ng'at moro nowachone niya, "Abiro luwi kamoro amora midhiye."
Yesu nodwoko niya, "Bwe nigi buchegi, kendo winy moriere e polo nigi utegi; to Wuod Dhano onge gi kama oketie wiye."
To nowacho ne ng'at machielo ni, "Luwa." To ng'atno nodwoko niya, "Ruoth, yiena mokwongo adog ayik wuora."
Yesu nowachone niya, "We joma otho oyik joggi motho; to in, dhi iland piny ruoth Nyasaye."
To pod ng'at machielo moro bende nowacho niya, "Abiro luwi, Ruoth; to mokwongo, yiena adog agone oriti joodwa."
Yesu nodwoko niya, "Ng'at mosemako kwer dhok, to pod ng'iyo chien, ok owinjore ne piny ruoth Nyasaye."
10: Bang’ mani, Ruoth noyiero ji piero ariyo ga ariyo ma moko, kendo noorogi ariyo ariyo mondo otel nyime e taonde duto kod kamoro amora mane obiro dhiyo e.
Nowacho negi ni, "Cham ochiek mathoth, to jotich nok, kuom mano kwauru Ruodh keyo mondo oor jotich odhi e puothe mar keyo."
Dhiuru! Aorou oko mana ka rombe e dier ondiegi.
Kik uting’ ofuk pesa, kata sandug wuoth, kata mana opat o, kendo kik umos ng’ato e yo.
Ka udonjo e ot to wachuru mokuongo ni, kuwe obedi e odni.
Ka ng’at kuwe ni kanyo to kuwe maru nobed kuome; to ka ok kamano, to kuweuno noduog nu.
Beduru e odno, ka uchamo kendo umadho gimoro amora ma gimiyou, nimar jatich owinjore gi pokne. Kik uring ka ua e ot ka ot.
Ka udonjo e taon mi orwaku to chamuru gino ma oket e nyimu.
Changuru jomatuo man kanyo kendo wachnegiuru ni, “Loch Nyasaye chiegni kodu."
To ka udonjo e taon moro to ok orwaku, dhiuru e yoregi matindo kendo uwach ni,
"Kata mana buch taondu moko e tiendewa wateng’o kuomu. To beduru kung’eyo maler ni, ‘Loch Piny ruoth Nyasaye chiegni."
Awachonu ni, nobed maber berie ni Sodom maloyo taondno.

"Yaye mano kaka unune malit un jo Korazin! Yaye, mano kaka unune malit un jo Bethsaida! Nimar ka dine honni mutimnugi dinetim ni Turo gi Sidon to dine giselokre chon ka giruore gi lep guok, kendo gibet e buru."
To enobed maber berie ne Turo gi Sidon e ndalo mar ng’ado bura moloyo ne un.
To in Kapernaum bende ibiro ting’oi malo nyaka polo koso? Ooyo, ibiro boloi piny nyaka piny joma otho.
"Ng’at ma winjou, winja, ng’at modagi odagi, kendo ng’at modaga odagi Jal ma noora."
Ji piero ariyo gogo noduogo kod ilo mi giwacho ni, "Ruoth koda ka jochiende be winjowa e nyingi,"
Nodwoko niya; "Ne oneno Satan kalor aa e polo mana kamil polo."
Asemiyou loch mondo unyon thuonde gi thomoni kendo ulo teko duto mag jasigu bende onge gima nohinyu.
To kik uil ni jochiende winjou, to iluru ni nyingu ondiki e polo."

E saa nogo, ka Roho Maler nomiyo Yesu opong’ gi ilo, nowacho niya, "Apakoi, Wuoro, Ruodh polo gi piny, ni kech isepando gigi ne joma riek gi joma osomo, to ise fwenyogi ne nyithindo matindo. Ee, Wuoro, nimar mano e gima ne berni timo."
"Wuora osemiya gik moko duto, onge ng’ama ong’eyo Wuowi makmana Wuoro, kendo onge ng’ama ong’eyo Wuoro mak mana Wuowi kaachiel gi joma Wuowi oyiero mondo ofwenynegi."
Eka nolokore ir jopuonjrene kendo nowacho negi kar kendgi ni, “Ogwedhi wenge maneno gik munenogi."
Nimar awachonu ni jonabi mang’eny kod ruodhi negombo neno gik muneno to ne ok gineno kendo winjo gik muwinjo gi to ne ok giwinjo."
Chieng’ moro achiel, ng’at moro molony e chik nochung mondo otem Yesu nopenjo ni, "Japuonj, ang’o ma nyaka atim moche were eka acham ngima?"
Nodwoko ni, "Ang’o mondiki e chik? Isome nade?"
Nomedo dwoke ni, "Her Ruoth Nyasachi gi chunyi duto gi dhandi duto, gi tekoni duto kendo gi pachi duto, bende her nyawadu kaka iherori iwuon."
Yesu nodwoke ni, "Isedwoko kare, tim kamano, eka inibed mangima."
To kaka nodwaro pwoyore kendo nomedo penjo Yesu ni, "Nyawada to en ng’a?"
Koro Yesu nodwoke niya, Ng’at moro nolor koa Jerusalem kadhi Jeriko kendo nopo kopodho e lwet jomecho. Ne gi lonyo lep e, gigoye, kendo giweye kochi egni tho.
To noyudo Jadolo moro lor koluwo yorno, to kane oneno ng’atno, nobaro moluwo bath yo komachielo.
Kamano bende, ja-Lawi moro kane ochopo kanyo monene nokadho gi komachielo.
To ja-Samaria moro kane ni e wuoth nochopo kama ne ng’atno nitie, kendo ka nonene, nokeche.
Nodhiyo ire motweyo adhondene kooloe mo kod divai. Eka noketo ng’atno e ng’e pundane owuon kendo notere e od buoro kendo norite maber.
Kinyne nogolo pesa mamingli mag fedha ariyo nomiyo jarit odno. Nowacho ne niya "Rite’ to ka aduogo abiro chuli nengo ma imedo ritego!"
"Kuom ji adekgi ere miparo ni ne en wadgi ng’at mane opodho e lwet jomechogo?"
Ng’at molony gi chik nodwoko ni en "Jal mane okeche." Eka Yesu nowachone ni, "Dhi kendo itim kamano."
Ka noyudo Yesu gi jopuonjrene nie yo, nochopo gweng’ kama dhako miluongo ni Maritha norwake e ode.
Ne en gi nyamin mane iluongo ni Mariam, mane obet piny, e tiend Ruoth kowinjo gima owacho.
To Maritha nodich gi tich mang’eny mane nyaka tim. Nodhiyo ire mopenjo ni, "Ruoth, ok idewo ni nyamera oweya atiyo mana kenda nyise mondo okonya!"
Ruoth nodwoke ni, "Maritha, Maritha, iparori kendo ithagori kuom gik mang’eny kayiem,"
to gimoro achiel kende ema dwarore. Mariam oseyiero gima ber moloyo kendo ok nomaye ngang’."
11: Chieng’ moro Yesu ne lamo kamoro. Kane otieko, achiel kuom jopuonjrene nowachone ni, "Ruoth, puonja lamo, kaka Johana bende nopuonjo jopuonjrene."
Nowachone ni, "Ka ulamo to wachuru ni, 'Wuonwa, nyingi mondo omi luor, pinyruoth manobi.'"
Miwa odiechieng’ kodiechieng’ chiembwa mapile.
Wenwa richowa nimar wan bende waweyo ni ji duto matimonwa marach. Kendo kik iterwa e tem."
Eka nowachonegi ni, “Ka dipo ng’at moro kuomu nigi osiepene to odhi dier otieno mi owachone ni, 'Osiepna, holae makati adek,'"
ni kech osiepna moro mane nie wuoth osebiro lima to aonge gimoro ma anyalo keto e nyime."
Eka jal mane nie ot nodwokoni ni, 'We chanda. Dhoot oselor, kendo nyithinda ni koda e otande. Ok anyal chungo kendo miyi gimora amora.'"
Akonu ni kata obedi ni ok onyal aa malo mondo omiye makati kaka osiepne, to nikech kinde ma ng’atno obiro oa malo mi miye moromo kaka odwaro."
Omiyo awachonu ni, "Kwauru to nomiu; dwaruru to unuyudi kendo duong’uru to noyawnu."
Nimar ng’ato ka ng’ato makwayo imiyo, ng’ato madwaro nwang’o, kendo ng’ama duong’o, noyawne dhoot."
En ng’a kuomu, wuone, ma ka wuodi okwaye rech, to imiye mana thuol?
Kata ka okwayi tong’ gweno, imiye mana okela?
Ka un, ma un joricho kamano, ung’eyo kaka duchiw mich mabejo ne nyithindu, koro Wuoro manie polo biro chiwo Roho Maler moromo nade ne joma nokwaye."
Chieng’ moro Yesu neriembo jachien ma momo. Kane jachien oa, ng’atno ma momo nowuoyo, kendo oganda nohum nono.
To moko kuomgi nowacho ni, "Beelzebub ruodh jochiende, ema ogologogo jochiende oko."
Jomoko to noteme ka kwaye ranyisi moa e polo.
Yesu nong’eyo parogi mi nowachonegi ni, "Pinyruoth mora amora mopogore owuon nyaka kethre, to ot mopogore kende biro gore piny."
Ka Satan opogore owuon, ere kaka pinyruothne nyalo chungo? Awacho mani nikech uwacho ni ariembo jochiende oko gi teko Beelzebub."
Koro ka ariembo jochiende oko gi teko Beelzebub, joma luwou to kara gologi gi teko mar ng’a? Emomiyo, ginibed jong’adnu bura.
To ka ariembo jochiende oko gi lwet Nyasaye, to loch Nyasaye osebironu.
Ka ng’at maratego, momanore gi lweny orito ode owuon, to gige duto ritore maber.
To ka ng’at maratego moloye omonje mi oloye to omayo ng’atno gi lweny mane okete e genone, kendo oyako gige odhigo.
Ng’at maok ni koda mon koda, kendo maok chok koda, keyo giga.
Ka jachien marach osewuok oa kuom ng’ato, odhiyo kuonde motwo koman yo kar yweyo to ok oyudi. Eka owacho niya, 'Abiro dok e oda mane aweyo.'"
Ka ochopo, to oyudo ka ot oywe maler kendo ochan maber.
Eka odhiyo kendo oomo jochiende abiriyo moko maricho moloye, kendo gibiro gidak kanye. To giko enni ngima ng’atno bedo marach moloyo, kaka nochalo mokwongo."
Ka noyudo Yesu wacho wechegi dhako moro manie ei ogandano nowacho matek ni, "Miyo mane onyuoli kendo odhodhi oguedhi."
Nodwoko niya, "Jogo moguedhi gin mana joma winjo wach Nyasaye kendo time."
Ka noyudo oganda medore, Yesu nowacho ni, "Ma en tieng’ marach. Okwayo ranyisi mar honni, to onge ma ibiro miye makmana ranyisi mar Jona."
To mana kaka Jona ne en ranyisi ne jo Nineve, e kaka Wuod Dhano biro bedo ne tieng’ni.
Ruoth madhako mar piny milambo nochung’ chieng’ bura kaachiel gi tieng’ni kendo enong’adnegi bura, ni mar noa e tung’ piny mondo owinj rieko Solomon, to koro nitie ng’ato ka maduong’ moloyo Solomon.
Jo Nineve biro chung’ e bura kaachiel gi tieng’ni kendo nonong’adnegi bura; nikech ka Jona ne oyalo negi to ne gilokore, to koro nitie ng’ato ka maduong’ moloyo Jona."
Onge ng’ato mamoko taya to okete kama obiro pondoe, kata e bwo sufuria. Kar timo kamano to okete e wi rachungitaya mondo jogo madonjo one ler.
Wang’i e taya mar ringruok, ka wengegi ber, ringri duto opong’ gi ler. To ka gi richo, ringri bende mudho opong’o.
Omiyo, neuru, ni ler manie iu ok en mudho.
Emomiyo, ka ringri duto opong’ gi ler, kendo ka onge mudho kuome kamora amora to obedo maler chutho, mana ka gima ler mar taya rieny kuomi."
Kane Yesu osetieko wuoyo, Jafarisai moro norwake mondo gichiem kode, omiyo nodonjo iye kendo nobedo kodgi e mesa.
To jafarisai kanoneno ni Yesu ne ok okuongo ologo motelo ni chiemo, nowuoro.
Eka Ruoth nowachone niya, "Koro un Jafarisai uliwoko ng’e kikombe gidise, gie chunyu to upong’ gi wuoro kod timbe maricho."
Un joma ofuwo gi! Donge Jal mane ochueyo ng’e gik moko, ema nochueyo koda igi bende?
To chiwuru gima nie idise ne joma odhier, eka gik moko duto biro bedunu maler.

Chandruok ochomou un Jafarisai, nikech uchiwo ne Nyasaye mich mar achiel kuom apar mar apoth gi odielo, kod alode mamoko mag puodho, to ujwang’o ng’ado bura kare kod hero Nyasaye. Owinjore utim gik machien-go, ka ok uweyo mak utimo mokwongogo."
Chandruok ochomou un Jafarisai, nikech uhero kombe madongo moloyo e sunago kendo mos echirne.
Chandruok ochomou nikech uchalo gi liete moumore ma ji wuotho kuomgi ka ok ging’eyo."
Achiel kuom jal molony e chik nodwoke ni, "Japuonj, ka iwuoyo kamano wan bende iyanyowa."
Yesu nodwoko ni, "Un joma olony e chik, bende chandruok ochomou nikech umiyo ji ting’ mapek maok ting’o yo tang’, to un uwegi ok unyal konyo gi ting’ogi kata mana gi lith lwetu."
Chandruok ochomou, nikech ugero, kendo umwono liete jonabi, to kwereu ema nonegogi.
Omiyo ka utimo kamano to koro unyiso ni uyie gi gima kwereu notimo, mane gin egogo jonabi, to un to koro umwono lietegi.
Kuom mano Nyasaye e riekone nowacho ni, 'Abiro oro negi jonabi gi joote, kendo moko kuomgi negi to moko ginisandi!'"
Emomiyo ibiro keto remb jonabi mosechuer duto e wi tieng’ni nyaka aa remb jonabi mosechwer aa chakruok piny.
Chakre remb Habil nyaka remb Zakaria, mane onegi e kind kendo mar misango kod kama ler. Ee awachonu ni tieng’ni ibiro kumo nikech mago duto.
Chandruok ochomou un joma olony e chik, nikech usemayo ji kifungu mar rieko. Un uwegi pok udonjo kendo joma donjo be usegeng’onegi."
Ka Yesu noa kanyo, Jo-Farisai gi Jopuonj Chik nochako kwede gi gero kendo ne gichande gi penjo mang’eny.
Ka girito mondo gimake gimoro amora mane onyalo wacho.
12: E kindeno, kane oganda mar ji mang’eny moromo alufe ne osechokore, makoro ginyonore giwegi, Yesu nochako wuoyo mokwongo, gi jopuonjrene kowacho niya, "Ritreuru ka utang’ ni thowi mar jo-Farisai, ma en wuon druok.
Onge gimoro mopandi maok bi fwenyore, kata maling’ling’ ma ok nong’ere.
Gima usewacho e mudho biro winjore e odichieng’ e lela, kendo gima usekwodho eitu ei ot maiye nolandi e wi tat ot.
Awachonu osiepna, kik uluor jogo manego ringruok to bang’e ok ginyal timo gimoro moloyo.
To abiro nyisou jalo monego uluor: Luoru ru jalno ma, bang’ nego ringruok, to en gi teko mar witou e ataro mar mach. Ee, awachonu, luoreuru.
Oyundi abich donge ing’iewo otonglo ariyo kende? To kata acheiel kuomgi wi Nyasaye ok wilgo.
Chutho, kata mana yiewiu duto okwan. Kik uluor, nikech uloyo oyundi mang’eny.
Awachonu, ng’ato ang’ata mahula e nyim ji, Wuod Dhano biro hule e nyim malaike mag Nyasaye.
To ng’ato ang’ata mokweda e nyim ji en bende nokwede e nyim malaike mag Nyasaye.
Kendo ng’at ang’ata mowacho wach marach kuom Wuod Dhano nowene, to ng’at mowacho wach mar achaye kuom Roho Maler ok nowene.
Ko kelu e sunagogi, e nyim jodongo gi jotelo, to kik uparru kuom kaka dudwok weche ma odonjnugo, kata gima duwachi,
nikech Roho Maler biro puonjou e sano gima onego uwach."
Ng’at moro mane ni ei oganda nowachone ni, "Japuonj, nyis owada mondo opogna gikeniwa."
Yesu noduoko ni, "Omera, ng’ama oketa jang’ad bura kata jathek e kindu?"
Eka nowacho nigini, "Ritreuru! Beduru motang’ ni kit wuoro duto; ngima mar dhano ok bedi ni mwandu mathoth ma en-go."
Kendo nowachonigi ngero ni: Puodhi ng’at moro ma jamoko nochiek maber.
Noparo e chunye ni, ‘Ang’o monego atim? Aonge kama dakanie chamba.’
Mi nowacho, ‘Ma egima abiro timo. Abiro muko dechena kendo gero moko madongo, kendo abiro kano chamba duto gi gigega kanyo.’
Eka anawach gie chunya ni, "In-gi gigi mang’eny maber misekano moromi kuom higni mang’eny. Koro ywe, chiem, methi kendo bed mamor."
To Nyasaye nowachone ni, ‘In ng’ama ofuwoni! Kawuono gotieno ni ang’ nokaw ngimani. Eka ng’ano mabiro kawo mago mise loso ni in iwuon?’
Mano e kaka nobed gi ng’ato ang’ata mokano gik moko ni en owuon to ok omeweyo Nyasaye.
Eka Yesu nowacho ni jopuonjrene, "Emomiyo awachonu ni kik uparru kuom ngimau, kuom gima ubiro chamo, kata kuom dendu, kuom gima durwak.
Ngima duong’ moloyo chiemo, dendi bende loyo lewni.
Paruuru ane winy: Maok chwo bende ok gikee, gionge gi kuonde keno kata dere; to Nyasaye pidho gi. To un donge uber moloyo winy.
To ng’ano kuomu manyalo medo saa achiel e ngimane nikech oparorore?
To kaka ok unyal timo mani matin-ni, ang’o momiyo uparori kuom gik mamoko?
Paruuru ane kaka odanyo dongo. Ok giti kata chwecho. To kata kamano awachonu ni kata mana Solomon e rwakruokne malich ok rom kodgi.
Ka kamano e kaka Nyasaye rwako lum mane pap, ma kawuono en tie to kiny iwite e mach, to koro un dorwaku, machal nade, yaye un man-gi yie matin.
Kendo kik uket chunyu kuom gima dicham kata madi madhi, kik uparru kuom mago.
Nikech joma ok oyie mane piny ringo kalawo gik ma kamago, Wuonu ong’eyo ni uchando gigo.
To dwaruuru pinyruodhe, eka magi bende biro medorenu.
Kik uluor un kweth matin, nikech Wuonu mor mar miyou pinyruot.
Lok gigi iyudgo pesa mondo imi joma odhier. Dwaruuru okepe maok yiechi, mwandu manie polo maok rum kuma jakuo ok chopie kata olwende ok keth.
Nikech kama mwanduni nitie ema chunyi bende nitie.
Rwakreuru kendo ikreuru ni tich, bende techeu obed ka liel,
ka joma rito ruodhgi maduogo koa e nyasi mar arus, mondo kobiro kendo oduong’o to giyawone dhoot piyo.
Nobed maber ni jotich ma ruodhgi noyud karito e kinde moduogo. Awachonu adiera ni norwakre gi lawe mondo omigi chiemo, nomi gibed e mesa mi nobi mopognigi chiemo.
Nobed maber ni jotije ma ruodhgi noyud ka oikore kata ka obiro e arita mar ariyo kata mar adek gotieno.
To ng’euru maber ni kadine wuon ot ng’e saa ma jakuo biroe to dine ok oweyo ode otur gi jakuo.
Omiyo nyaka uikru, nikech Wuod Dhano biro biro saa ma ok ung’eyo."
Petro nopenje, "Ruoth, iwacho ngeroni ni wan koso ni ji duto?"
To Ruoth noduoko, "En ng’a maja adier kendo majatelo mariek ma ruodhe miyo tich mar rito jotije miyogi chiembgi e saa mowinjore?
Jatijno none ber ka ruodhe oduogo moyude ka otimo kamano.
Awachonu adieri ni nokete mondo orit mwandune duto.
To ka jatich owacho e chunye owuon ni, ‘Ruodha okawo ndalo mathoth kapok oduogo’, mi ochako goyo jotich machuo gi mon kendo ochako chiemo kendo gi metho, kod mer,
ruodh jatijno nobi e odiechieng’ maok opar ni dobie kendo e saa maok ong’eyo, obiro ng’ade matindo tindo mi nokete gi joma ok oyie.
Jatijno mong’eyo dwaro mar ruodhe to ok otem timo gima ruodhe dwaro, nochwad mang’eny.
To mano maok ong’eyo to otimo gik mowinjore gi kum, to nochwad manok. Ng’ato ka ng’ato mosemi mang’eny nodwar kuome gik mang’eny, to jal mosemi mang’eny mondo oriti, enopenje mang’eny moloyo.
Asebiro mondo amok mach e-piny to mano kaka agombo ni madne bed ni osemo ke!
Nitie batiso monego ayudi. To mano kaka chunya chandore nyaka chop otimre!
Uparo ni ne abiro mondo akel kuwe e piny? Ooyo, to awachonu ni ne akelo mana pogruok.
Chakre kawuono kadhi nyime ji abich ma joot achiel biro pogore, ji adek odok kon achiel to ji ariyo bende ni koma chielo.
Gibiro pogore, wuoro pogore gi wuode kendo wuowi bende pogore gi wuon, miyo nopogre gi nyare to nyako bende nopogre gi min, dayo nopogre gi chi wuode, chi wuowi bende nopogre gi damare.
Nowacho ni oganda ni, "Kuneno ka boche polo chokore yo podho chieng’ to piyo piyo uwacho ni koth biro chwe, to timore kamano!
Kendo ka yamb milambo kudho to uwacho ni oro biro, to kamano e kaka timore.
Andho kegi! Ka ulony kuom rango chal mar piny gi polo to ang’o momiyo ok unyal ng’eyo gik matimore ndalogi?
Nikech ang’o ok unyal ng’eyo ngima kare?

Ka idhi gi ng’ama odonjoni e nyim jang’ad bura, tem matek mondo iwuo kode kendo uwinjru kapod un eyo, ka ok kamano to obiro ywayi koteri ir jang’ad bura, to jang’ad bura biro keti e lwet askari to askari biro boli e jela.
Awachoni ni ok niwuog oko nyaka ichul pesa duto."
13: E kindeno ne nitie jomoko mane obiro mi wach ne Yesu kuom Jo-Galili mane Pilato ne ochiwo rembgi gi misengini maggi.
Yesu nodwokogi niya, Uparo ni Jo-Galili-gi ne joricho moloyo Jo-Galili mamoko duto nikech ne gisandore kamano?
Awachonu ni, Ooyo! To ka ok ulokoruwe yo richou, un bende duto unu tho kamano.
Kata japar gaboro kamano tho kane ohinga e Silaom nopodho kuomgi, uparo ni negin joketho moloyo ji mamoko duto madak e Jerusalem?
Awachonu ni, Ooyo! To ka ok ulokoruwe yo richou, un bende ubiro mana tho.
Eka nogoyo ngeroni niya, Ng'at moro ne nigi yadh ng'owo mopidho e puothe, to nodhi mondo orang olemo kuome, to ok noyudo moro amora.
Omiyo nowacho ni ng'at mane rito puodho ni, Kuom higni adek asebedo kabiro kae adwaro olemo e ng'owoni to ok aseyudo moro amora. Ng'ole igoye piny. Ere gima dimi ocham lowo?
Ng'atno nodwoke ni, Jaduong', weye higani kende bang'e to abiro pure kendo medo ketone owuoyo.
Ka onyago olemo higa mabiro, manober, to ka ok onyago, to nong'ole oko.
Chieng' Sabato moro Yesu ne puonjo ji e achiel kuom sunagoge,
to dhako moro ne nikanyo mane jachien osemiyo obedo mong'ol kuom higini apar gaboro. Nidekre nodole maok nonyal riere tir kata matin.
Kane Yesu onene, noluonge obi nyime kendo nowachone ni, Dhako, ogonyi ibed thuolo ichangi e midekreni.
Eka noketo lwete kuome, to gikanyono noriere tir kendo nopako Nyasaye.
Jaduong' od lemo, mirima nomako nikech Yesu nochango dhakono chieng' Sabato, nowacho ni ji niya, Nitie ndalo auchiel mitiyo e. Omiyo biuru mondo ochangu e ndalogo, to ok chieng' Sabato.
Ruoth nodwoke ni, Un joma wuon dore! Donge ng'ato ka ng'ato kuomu gonyo rwadhe kata pundane e kul kotere oko mondo omiye pi?
Koro dhakoni, ma nyakwar Ibrahim, ma Satan osetueyo higini apar gaborogi mabor, kama donge ber kogo ni obed thuolo chieng' Sabato oa e gima notweye?
Kane owacho mani, jogo duto mane pinge wigi nokuot. To ji mamoko nomor kod gik moko duto miwuoro mane otimo.
Eka Yesu nopenjo, niya, Ere kaka loch pinyruodh Nyasaye chalo? Ang'o madapim go?
Ochalo kod koth karadali, ma ng'ato nokawo kendo opidho e puothe. Nodongo mobed yien, to winy mag polo nogedo e bedene.
Nopenjo kendo ni, Ang'o madapim go loch pinyruodh polo mar Nyasaye?
Ochalo thowi ma dhako kawo kendo oruwo ei mogo mang'eny, mi bang'e okuot.
Eka Yesu nodhiyo e taonde kod gwenge kopuonjo ji ka odhiyo Jerusalem.
Ng'ato moro nopenjo niya, Ruoth, en mana ji manok emabiro kwo?
Nowachonigi niya, Temuru matek mondo udonje dhoot madiny, nikech awachonu ni, ji mang'eny biro temo mondo odonj to ok gibi nyalo ng'ang'.
Ka wuon ot nochung' kendo lor dhoot, ubiro chungo oko ka uduong'o kendo sayo ni, Jaduong', yawnwa dhoot. To obiro dwokou ni, Ok ang'eyo u kata kuma uae akia!
Eka ubiro wacho ni, Ne wachiemo kendo metho kodi, bende ne ipuonjoe yorewa matindo.
To obiro dwoko ni, Ok ang'eyo u, kata kuma uae akia. Auru kuoma un jomatimo maricho!
Ywagruok biro bedo kanyo no, kod muodo lak, ka uneno Ibrahim, Isaka gi Jakobo gi jonabi duto manie Pinyruoth Nyasaye to un uwegi nowitu oko.
Ji biro biro koa yo wuok chieng' kod yo podho chieng', gi nyadwat kod milambo, kendo gibed e keregi e kar nyasi mar chiemo e Pinyruoth Nyasaye.
Adiera chutho nitie jomoko makoro nichien mabiro telo, to jomotelo mabiro dong' chien.
Gi e kindeno Jofarisai moko nobiro ir Yesu kendo nowachone ni, Ai ka kendo dhiyo kamachielo nikech Herode dwaro negoi.
Nodwoke ni, Dhiuru uwachne kibweno, Abiro golo jochiende kendo chango ji kawuononi gi kiny, to chieng' mar adek abiro chopo dwarona.
To kata kamano nyaka adhi nyime kawuononi, gi kiny kod orucha nikech adiera onge, janabi ma nyalo tho oko mar Jerusalem!
Yaye, Jerusalem, Jerusalem, ma nego jonabi kendo chielo gi kite jogo moori iri, didi, masedwaroe mondo achok nyithindi kaachiel, mana kaka gweno choko nyithinde e bwo mbe, to ok useyie.
Ne, odi odong' gunda. Awachoni, ok ini nena kendo nyaka iniwach ni, Ogwedh ng'ama biro e nying Ruoth.
14: Chieng’ Sabato moro, kane Yesu odhi chiemo e od Jafarisai moro ma rahuma, nobedo ka ne ing’iye ahinya.
To e nyime kanyo ne tije ng’at mane mbunda ohingo.
Yesu nopenjo jafarisai kod jomolony e chik ni, En gima owinjore gi chik mondo ochang ng’at e chieng’ Sabato koso?
To ne giling’ thi. Eka nokawo ng’atno, nochange kendo noweye odhi.
Eka nopenjogi ni, Ka ng’ato kuomu nigi wuode kata rwadhe mopodho e soko chieng’ Sabato, donge diywaye igole oko mana gikanyono?
To ne gionge gima digiwachi.
Kane oneno kaka welo yiero kuondegi mag bet moyiedhi e kar mesa, nogoyo nigi ngeroni ni,
Ka ng’ato oluongou e nyasi mar kisera to kik ibed e kom moyiedhi, nimar dipo ka ng’ato moro mogen moloyoi oluongi bende.
Eka ka ng’ama oluongou ji ariyo gi ka obiro mowachoni ni, Mi jali komi. Kamano eka wiyi nokuodi nyaka inidhi ikaw kom kar bet man chien moloyo.

To ka oluongi e nyasi moro mar kisera kamoro to bed mana e kom man chien moloyo, mondo ka ng’at moluongino obiro to obiro wachoni ni, Osiepa, sudi malo nyime kama berni! Kamano iniyud luor e nyim welo weteni duto.
Nimar ng’ato ang’ata ma ting’ore malo nodwok piny, to jalo madwokore piny noting’ malo.

Eka Yesu nowacho ni ng’at mane oluongeno ni, Ka ichiwo chiemb odiechieng’ kata chiemb otieno, kik iluong mana osiepeni, oweteni kata wedeni, kata joweng’u momew, nimar ka itimo kamano, kamoro giniluongi chieng’ moro, mi gichuli kar luong mane iluongigo no.
To ka iloso nyasi, iluong joma odhier, rang’onde gi pudhe kod muofni,
Eka ibiro gwedhoi kata obedo ni ok ginyal chuloi, to nochuli chieng’ chier mar joma kare.
Ka achiel kuom jogo mane ni kode e mesa nowinjo ma, nowacho ni Yesu ni, Ogwedhi ng’atno mabiro chiemo e nyasi mar Pinyruoth Nyasaye.
Yesu nodwoke ni, Ng’at moro ne oloso nyasi maduong’ kendo noluongo welo mang’eny.
Gi e kindeno mar nyasi nooro jotichne mondo onyisi jogo mane oluongi, Biuru, nikech gik moko duto koro oseiko.
To giduto machalre ne gichako wacho weche ma ginyisogo wuon nyasigi momiyo ok ginyal biro. Jal mokwongo nowacho ni, Koro eka aseng’iewo puodho moro, to nyaka adhi mondo anene. Yie ing’wonna.
Jal machielo nowacho ni, Koro eka ang’iewo joge abich mag rweth pur, to adhiyo mondo atemgi, yie mondo ing’wonna.
Jal machielo pod nowacho bende ni, Eka akendo, omiyo ok anyal biro.

Jatich nodwogo kendo nowacho kamano ni ruodhe. Eka wuon ot nobedo mager kendo nowacho ni jatichne niya, Wuogi idhi mapiyo e yore matindo kode kuonde mopondo mag taon mondo ikel joma odhier gi rang’onde, muofni kod pudhe.
Jatich nowacho ni, Jaduong’ gima nende ichokowa osetim, to pod thuolo nitie.
Eka jaduong’ nowacho ni jatichne ni, Wuogi idhiyo oko e yore madongo kod yore mag gweng’ kendo ikel gibi gidonji, mondo oda opong’.
Awachonu ni, onge kata ng’ato achiel kuom jogo mane oluongi manobil chiemba.
Ka ji mang’eny ne wuotho kod Yesu, eka nolokore irgi mowachonigi niya,
Ka ng’ato obiro ira, to ok okwedo wuon gi min kod chiege gi nyithinde, owete gi nyiminene ee, kata ngimane owuon, ok onyal bedo japuonjrena.
To ng’ato maok oting’o msalape owuon mi oluwa ok onyal bedo japuonjrena.
Ka dibed ni achiel kuomu dwaro gero ohinga. Donge obiro bedo piny mokwongo mondo okwan nengo ne mondo one ka en gi pesa moromo mar tieke?
Nimar ka oketo mise to ok onyal tieke, ji duto manene biro nyiere,
Ka giwacho ni, Jali nochako gedo to ok onyal tieko.

Kata ka dibed ni ruoth moro dwaro dhiyo e lweny e kinde gi ruoth machielo. Donge mokwongo dobed piny mondo opar anena ka ji alufu apar ma en-go bende onyalo kedogo gi jal mabiro monje man-gi ji alufu piero ariyo?
Ka ok donyal, to obiro oro joote ka pod jal machielo pod ni kuma bor, mondo onyise ni odwaro mondo giwinjre e yor kuwe.
Machalre kamano bende, ng’ato kuomu maok oweyo gige duto ok onyal bedo japuonjrena.
Chumbi ber, to ka ndhathe orumo, ere kaka dimiye obed gi ndhadhu kendo?
Ok owinjore ne tich lowo kata mana pidh owuoyo, omiyo ipuke oko. Ng’at man gi it mar winjo, mondo owinji.
15: Koro josol osuru gi joricho nochokore machiegni mondo giwinje.
To Jo-Farisai gi jopuonj chik ne ng’ur kawacho ni, Ng’atni rwako joricho kendo ochiemo kodgi.
Eka Yesu nogoyo nigi ngero ni:
Ka ng’ato kuomu dibedi ni nigi rombe mia achiel, to olalo achiel kuomgi. Donge odowe piero ochiko go ochiko e pap kama ler kendo odhi omany rombo molal nyaka oyude?
To ka oyude, okete e goke komor.
Kendo odhiyo dala. Eka oluongo osiepene gi jogweng’gi kaachiel, kowacho ni, Moruru koda, aseyudo nyarombna mayandi olal.
Awachonu ni kamano e kaka mor nobedi e polo kuom jaricho achiel molokore, moloyo mor kuom ji piero ochiko go ochiko mabeyo maok dwar lokruok.
Kata ka dibed ni nitie dhako mangi silinge mamingli apar, to achiel olalne. Donge domok taya, kendo yweyo ot to omany maber ahinya mondo oyude?
To ka oyude, oluongo osiepene gi jogweng’gi kaachiel, kowacho ni, Moruru koda, aseyudo pesana manolal.
Mana kamano, awachonu e kaka mor e nyim malaika mag Nyasaye nobedie kuom jaricho achiel molokore.
Yesu nomedo wacho niya, Ne nitie ng’ato moro mane nigi yawuowi ariyo.
Wuowi machogo nowacho ni wuon mare ni, Wuora, pogna mwanduna mamara, kuom mano nopogo yawuote ariyo go mwandune.
Bang’ ndalo manok ne mano, wuowi machogo nokawo gige duto, eka nowuok modhiyo e piny mabor to kuro notiyo gi mwandune e yor dak e ngima mar anjawo.
Kane osetieko gik moko duto, kech mager nowuok e pinyno duto, eka nochako bedo gi chando.
Eka nodhiyo kochiwore owuon mondo oti ni japinyno, mane oore e lawe mondo opidhne nguru e.
Nogombo mondo ocham opong’ go iye opokla ma ngurue chamo, to bende onge ng’ato mane omiye gimoro.
Kane parone oduogo ne, nowacho niya, Gin ji adi mondiki mag wuora man gi chiemo moromogi, madong’. To an ka eri kech chama mar tho!
Abiro wuok kendo adog ir wuora mi anawache ni: Wuora, asetimo richo e nyim polo kendo e nyimi.
Ok awinjora koro oluonga ni wuodi; keta abed kaka achiel kuom jotich ni.
Omiyo noa malo kendo nodhiyo ir wuon mare. To kane pod en kuma bor, wuon mare nonene kendo kopong’ gi kech kuome, noringo kodhiyo ir wuode, nokwake gi bade kendo nonyo dhe.
Wuowino nowachone niya, Wuora, asetimo richo e nyim polo kendo e nyimi. Ok awinjora koro mondo oluonga ni wuodi.
To wuon mare nowacho ni jotichne niya, Piyo piyo, kelu ru law maberiemo loyo mondo urwakne. Ketneu ru tere e lith lwete kendo wuoche mondo urwakne e tiendene.
Keluru nyarwath machwe uyang’. Wachamuru wabed mamor.
Nikech wuodani yande otho, to koro onwang’e. Kamano negichako timo nyasika gimor.
E kindeno, noyudo ka wuowi maduong’ nie puodho. Kane obiro machiegni gi ot nowinjo wer gi miel.
Omiyo noluongo achiel kuom jotich kendo nopenje ni en ang’o matimore.
Nodwoke ni, Owadu oseduogo, to wuoru osenego nyarwath machwe nikech oseduogo kongima kendo maber.
To wuowi maduong’ mirima nomako, kendo notamore donjo e ot. Omiyo wuon mare nowuok oko odhiyo ire kendo nosaye mondo odonji.
To nodwoko wuon mare niya, Neye, higini gi duto asebedo katiyoni ka misumba kendo aserito katimo chikeni. To eka pok imiyoa kata mana nyadiel mondo ayang’, abed go mamor kod osiepena.
To ka wuodi ni, moseketho gigegi gi mon ma jochode ka obiro dala, to inego ne nyarwath machwe!
Wuon mare nowacho niya, Wuoda, in koda ndalo duto, kendo gik moko duto ma an-go’ gin magi.
To nyaka ne wabed mamor kendo bed moil, nikech owaduni yande otho to koro ongima, kendo yande olal to koro oyude!
16: Yesu nowacho ne jopuonjrene niya, "Ne nitie jamoko moro, ma ng'at mane rito mwandune ne odenje ni ketho gige.
Omiyo noluonge ire kendo nopenje ni, ‘En ang'o mawinjo kuomi ni? Chiwani kwan kuom gigo duto mirito, nikech ok inyal bedo jarit giga kendo.
Jarit nowachone en owuon ni, ‘Abiro timo ang'o koro? Ruodha koro maya tija. Ok an rat ego moromo ma dapu, to wiya kuot mondo akwechi.
Ang'eyo gima abiro timo, ma ka aweyo tich ka to ji biro rwakae utegi!’
Omiyo noluongo jogope ruodhe achiel achiel. Nopenjo mokwongo ni, ‘In gi gop ruodha maromo nadi?’
Nodwoko ni, ‘Galande mia aborom ag mo.’ Jarit tich nowachone ni, ‘Bed piny piyo piyo, ikaw kitapi indikie ni, mia ang'wen.’
Eka nopenjo jal mar ariyo ni, ‘In to, gopi oromo adi?’ Nodwoko ni, ‘Gunde alufu mag ngano.’ Nowachone ni, ‘Kaw kitapini, indike ni mia aborom.’
Ruoth nopako jarit gige maok kareno nikech notiyo gi rieke. Nimar jopinyni ong'eyo tiyo mariek gi jowadgi moloyo jogo mag chieng'.
Awachonu ni, tiuru gi mwandu mag piny mondo umakgo osiepe ne un uwegi, mondo ka orumo, norwaku e kar dak manyaka chieng'.
Ng'at minyalo geno gima tin inyal gene bende gi gik mang'eny, ma to ng'at ma ok jadiera gi gima tin bende ok inyal gadiera gi gik mang'eny.
Emo miyo ka ok usebedo joadiera e tiyo gi mwandu mar pinyni, ng'ano mabiro genou gi mwandu madier?
To ka ok usebedo joadiera gi mwandu ng'at machielo, ng'ano madimiu mwandu ma maru uwegi?
Onge jatich manyalo tiyo ni ruodhi ariyo. Nimar obiro sin gi achiel to ohero machielo, kata obiro chiwore ni achiel to ochayo machielo. Ok inyal tiyo ni Nyasaye kendo ni pesa."
Jo-Farisai mane ohero pesa nowinjo magi duto kendo neginyiero kagi jaro Yesu.
Nowachonigi ni, "Un ema uketoru kare uwegi e wang' ji, to Nyasaye ong'eyo chunyu. Gima okaw ni ber ahinya gi ji, kuom Nyasaye en gima ichayo.
Chik kod Jonabi nolandi nyaka chop ndalo mar Johana. Chakre kanyo, wach maber mar Pinyruodh Nyasaye osebedo kilando, kendo ng'ato ka ng'ato riyo remo mondo odonjie.
To yot mondo polo gi piny orum, moloyo ka nukta achiel matinie moloyo mar chik ok lal.
Ng'ato moriembo chiege kendo okendo dhako machielo, otimo tim chode, to ng'at mokendo dhako ma chwore oriembo, to en bende otimo tim chode."
"Ne nitie jamoko moro mane rwako lewni mokikore kendo marep rep mabeyo ma nengogi tek, kendo nodak e ngima mamalo mar mor ndalo duto.
Edho rangaye noketie jakwecho miluongo ni Lazaro, ma adhonde nopong'o dende,
kendo nogombo chamo ng'injo molware bwo mesa jamoko no. Kata mana guogi bende nobiro minang' adhondege.
Saa nochopo ma jakwecho notho kendo malaika noting'e, otere e bath Ibrahim. Jamoko bende notho kendo noike.
Kane en e Piny Joma otho kisande malit, nong'yo malo to noneno Ibrahim gi kuma mabor kod Lazaro e bathe.
Omiyo noluonge kowacho niya, ‘Wuora Ibrahim kecha kendo or Lazaro olut lith lwete e pi mondo okwena lewa, nikech an-gi rem malit e ligegani.’
To Ibrahim nodwoko ni, ‘Wuoda, parie ni e ndalo mar ngimani ne iyudo gik mabeyo, ka Lazaro to ne yudo gik maricho, to koroni oneno maber ka eri, to in inie rem malit.
To bende moloyo ne mano duto, e kindwa kodi nitie hoho mang'ongo moseketi, mondo otam jogo ma dwaro aa ka obi iru, kata ng'ato ok inyal ng'ado oako ru obi irwa koni.’
Nodwoko ni, ‘Koro akwayoi, wuora, or Lazaro odhi od wuora,
nimar an-gi owetena abich. Odhiyo osiemgi, mondo kik gin bende gibi e kar sand malitni.’
Ibrahim nodwoko ni, ‘Gin kod Musa gi Jonabi, owinjore gi winjgi.’
Nowacho ni, ‘Ooyo wuonwa Ibrahim, to ka ng'ato oa kuom joma otho modhi irgi, ginyalo loko re.’
Nowachone ni, ‘Ka ok ginyal winjo Musa gi Jonabi, ok ginyal yie winjo kata ng'ato chier aa kuom joma otho.’”
17: Yesu nowacho ni jopuonjrene niya, Gik makelo chwanyruok nyaka bi, to chandok ochomo jalno makelo gi!
Dine berne ka ditwoyone kidi maduong’ e pienge mi iwite e dho nam, moloyo ka odichwanyo achiel kuom nyithindo matinni.
Ritreure! Ka owadu otimoni marach, kwere to ka olokore koweyo richone, weye.
Ka otimoni marach nyadi abiriyo e odiechieng’ achiel, kendo nyadi abiriyo obiro iri owachoni ni, ‘Koro alokora aweyo richona’ – yie iweye.
Joote nowacho ni Ruoth ni, Mednwayie.
Ruoth nodwoko ni, Ka dine un-gi yie matien chalo koth karadali, dine uwachoni ni yadh ng’owoni, ‘Dhieng’ riketh idhi ipidhr e nam,’ kendo dinere owinjou.
En ng’a kuomu man-gi jatich ma dapur, kata makwadho, mane diwuoche kowuok e lek niya, ‘Bi mapiyo kero ibed piny ichiem’?
Donge diduyisore ni, ‘Ikna chiemo, kendo lwar lawi mondo ikon ya, nyaka atiek chiemo kendo metho, bang’e eka inibed ni ichiemo kendo imetho?
Donge ok ogoyone erokamano, nikech ose timo gano modogore ni otim?
Kamano bende, un, ka osetimo gik moko duto mowachonu, ubinuwach, ‘Wan mana jotich mapeonge gi tich mabor; wasetimo mana gino modogore watim.’
Kane Yesu dhi Jerusalem, noriyo e kind Samaria gi Galili,
To ka nodonjo e dala achiel moro matin, chwo apar man-gi dhoho noromokodre.
Negichung’ mabor, kendo negigoyo koko matek kowacho ni, Yesu, Japuonj, kechwa!
